_comment: IMPORTANT: This file contains manually verified analysis of all 53 RNA agent tools. DO NOT DELETE OR OVERWRITE without preserving a backup. Generated from upstream source code and original documentation, not from wrapper code.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: 包含 RNA/DNA 序列的文件路径（纯文本或 FASTA）。服务会过滤掉标题行、将 T 转为 U、移除非 A/U/G/C 字符。
parameters.impact_on_result: 直接决定参与计算的序列内容，从而改变 gc_count、c_count、g_count 与 gc_content。
parameters.example: 序列为 'AUGCGC' 时 gc_content=4/6≈0.667；若改为 'AUGUAU'，gc_content=1/6≈0.167。

constraints.other: 文件必须存在；内容为纯文本或 FASTA；归一化时会跳过 '>' 开头的标题行，将 T 转为 U，并移除非 A/U/G/C 字符；归一化后序列长度必须大于 0。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: rna_sequence_metrics_service 的 /gc-content 端点地址。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响请求发往哪个服务端点；不改变 GC 计算值（除非指向实现不同的服务）。
parameters.example: 保持默认值即可得到标准 GC 分数；改为错误地址会导致请求失败。

constraints.other: 必须是有效的 HTTP/HTTPS URL，默认指向 rna_sequence_metrics_service 的 /gc-content 端点。

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: HTTP 请求超时时间（秒）。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响网络超时行为，不影响 GC 计算结果。
parameters.example: 对大文件可设为 300.0，但 gc_content 不变。

constraints.other: 必须为正数（秒），仅影响网络请求超时。

compute_rna_sequence_gc_content.notes: 真正计算在 sequence_utils.compute_gc_content 中完成：gc_content = (G+C)/N，N 为归一化后 AUGC 长度。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: 包含 RNA/DNA 序列的文件路径。服务同样会 T→U、过滤非 A/U/G/C。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定 u_count 与 u_fraction 的值。
parameters.example: 'AUGUAU' 的 u_fraction=3/6=0.5；改为 'AUGCGC' 后 u_fraction=0。

constraints.other: 文件必须存在；内容为纯文本或 FASTA；归一化时会跳过 '>' 开头的标题行，将 T 转为 U，并移除非 A/U/G/C 字符；归一化后序列长度必须大于 0。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: rna_sequence_metrics_service 的 /u-content 端点地址。
parameters.impact_on_result: 只决定请求目标，不影响 U 含量计算。
parameters.example: 使用默认值得到标准 u_fraction。

constraints.other: 必须是有效的 HTTP/HTTPS URL，默认指向 /u-content 端点。

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: HTTP 请求超时时间（秒）。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响网络超时，不影响结果。
parameters.example: 设为 60.0 仍返回相同 u_fraction（只要服务正常）。

constraints.other: 必须为正数（秒），仅影响网络请求超时。

compute_rna_sequence_u_content.notes: u_fraction = U 数量 / 归一化后 AUGC 长度；空序列返回 0.0。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: 包含 dot-bracket 二级结构的文件路径；允许 FASTA 格式，标题行会被跳过。
parameters.impact_on_result: 直接决定结构长度与 '.' 数量，从而改变 unpaired_fraction。
parameters.example: 结构 '((..))' 的 unpaired_fraction=2/6≈0.333；改为 '......' 则为 1.0。

constraints.other: 文件必须存在；允许 FASTA 或纯文本；解析后会跳过 '>' 标题行；结构字符串只能包含 . ( ) [ ] { } < >，且不能为空。
constraints.description: Path to dot-bracket structure file; accepted chars: . ( ) [ ] { } < >

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: rna_sequence_metrics_service 的 /unpaired-fraction 端点地址。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅决定请求目标，不改变未配对比例。
parameters.example: 默认值即可得到标准结果。

constraints.other: 必须是有效的 HTTP/HTTPS URL，默认指向 /unpaired-fraction 端点。

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: HTTP 请求超时时间（秒）。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响网络超时。
parameters.example: 设为 30.0 仍返回相同 unpaired_fraction。

constraints.other: 必须为正数（秒），仅影响网络请求超时。

compute_dot_bracket_unpaired_fraction.notes: unpaired_fraction = '.' 数量 / 结构总长度；只接受 . ( ) [ ] { } < > 字符。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: CDS 序列文件路径（FASTA 或纯文本），长度需为 3 的倍数，只允许 AUGC。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变密码子组成，从而改变 CAI。
parameters.example: 相同氨基酸序列下，'AUG AAA GAA'（人类高表达偏好）的 CAI 高于 'AUG AAG GAG'。

constraints.other: 文件必须存在且可读；内容为 FASTA 或纯文本；归一化后必须至少包含一个 A/U/G/C；序列长度必须是 3 的倍数；T 会被转为 U；只允许 AUGC。
constraints.description: Path to in-frame CDS sequence file (FASTA or plain text); only AUGC/T accepted

parameters.name: species
parameters.description: 参考物种，决定使用哪套 Kazusa 密码子使用表。支持 human、mouse、yeast、ecoli 等别名。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变相对适应度权重，同一序列在不同物种下 CAI 不同。
parameters.example: 人类高表达偏好序列在 yeast 参考表下 CAI 通常会下降。

constraints.other: 支持别名（不区分大小写）。若不使用内置表，则必须提供 custom_codon_table_path。
constraints.description: Built-in species name or alias. If unmatched, provide custom_codon_table_path.

parameters.name: custom_codon_table_path
parameters.description: 可选的自定义密码子使用 JSON 文件路径；若提供则忽略内置表。
parameters.impact_on_result: 使用自定义频率构建权重，可使 CAI 完全由用户定义的偏好决定。
parameters.example: 若自定义表使 AAA 的 fraction 为同氨基酸最高，则序列多用 AAA 会得到更高 CAI。

constraints.other: 可选；若提供则必须是存在的 JSON 文件，格式为 {"codon": {"aa": "X", "fraction": float}, ...}。提供后忽略内置 species 表。
constraints.description: Optional custom codon-usage JSON file path

compute_cai_for_cds_sequence.notes: CAI 为有效密码子权重几何平均；终止密码子 UAA/UAG/UGA 被排除。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: CDS 序列文件路径，需为 3 的倍数且只含 AUGC。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定可置换的密码子池与原始 CAI。
parameters.example: 以人类胰岛素 CDS 起始段为例，改变序列会生成不同的同义变体。

constraints.other: 文件必须存在且可读；内容为 FASTA 或纯文本；归一化后必须至少包含一个 A/U/G/C；序列长度必须是 3 的倍数；T 会被转为 U；只允许 AUGC。
constraints.description: Path to in-frame CDS sequence file (FASTA or plain text); only AUGC/T accepted

parameters.name: junction_end
parameters.description: 'n_terminus' 或 'c_terminus'，分别打乱 5' 端或 3' 端密码子。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定哪些密码子位置被扰动，从而改变局部二级结构与 CAI。
parameters.example: n_terminus 会改变前几个密码子，c_terminus 则改变末尾几个密码子。

constraints.other: n_terminus 打乱 5' 端密码子，c_terminus 打乱 3' 端密码子。

parameters.name: codon_count
parameters.description: 被打乱的末端密码子数量（1–12，实际不超过 CDS 总密码子数）。
parameters.impact_on_result: 数量越大，可产生的序列变化越多，但受总长度上限限制。
parameters.example: codon_count=2 仅改变前两个密码子；设为 12 可改变前 12 个密码子。

constraints.other: 实际取值会被钳制为 CDS 总密码子数（min(codon_count, total_codons)）。

parameters.name: num_variants
parameters.description: 期望返回的变体数量（1–32）。
parameters.impact_on_result: 影响返回列表长度；若同义位置有限可能无法生成这么多唯一变体。
parameters.example: num_variants=1 只返回 CAI 最高的一个变体；设为 32 可返回更多候选。

constraints.other: 最多返回 32 个唯一变体；若同义可替换位置不足，可能返回更少。

parameters.name: species
parameters.description: 参考物种，用于密码子使用加权采样与 CAI 计算。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变同义密码子被选中的概率及 CAI 评估基准。
parameters.example: 使用 yeast 表时偏好密码子与人类不同，变体排序会变化。

constraints.other: 支持别名（不区分大小写），用于同义密码子加权采样与 CAI 计算。

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: 随机种子，用于复现生成的变体集合。
parameters.impact_on_result: 相同 seed 会得到相同的变体顺序与内容；不同 seed 可能产生不同变体。
parameters.example: seed=42 与 seed=42 两次运行结果一致；seed=43 通常会得到不同序列。

constraints.other: 可选整数随机种子；相同种子可复现变体集合。

shuffle_cds_junction_codons.notes: 同义密码子按该物种密码子使用频率加权随机选择；若末端没有可替换的同义密码子，则返回空 variants 列表。

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: 需要回显的字符串，长度至少为 1。
parameters.impact_on_result: 直接决定返回的 echo 值与 length 值。
parameters.example: text='hello' 返回 echo='hello'、length=5；改为 'world' 则 length=5 但 echo 改变。

constraints.other: 非空字符串（Pydantic min_length=1）；直接决定返回的 echo 与 length。

workflow_demo_echo.notes: 纯演示工具，仅返回输入字符串及其长度，不做生物计算。

parameters.name: reference_pdb_filepath
parameters.description: 参考结构 PDB 文件路径。
parameters.impact_on_result: 作为 RMSD/TM-score 的对齐基准。
parameters.example: 更换为不同折叠参考结构会显著改变 RMSD 与 TM-score。

constraints.other: 参考结构文件路径，必须存在且能被 Bio.PDB.PDBParser/MMCIFParser 解析。
constraints.description: Path to reference PDB file

parameters.name: predicted_pdb_filepath
parameters.description: 待评估预测结构 PDB 文件路径。
parameters.impact_on_result: 直接决定被评估坐标的集合。
parameters.example: 同一参考下，预测结构越接近参考，RMSD 越小、TM-score 越接近 1。

constraints.other: 预测结构文件路径，必须存在且能被 Bio.PDB.PDBParser/MMCIFParser 解析。
constraints.description: Path to predicted PDB file

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: 要对齐的链 ID；为空时自动选择第一条链。
parameters.impact_on_result: 选择不同链会得到不同的原子坐标集合，从而改变 RMSD/TM-score。
parameters.example: 若 PDB 含 A、B 两条 RNA 链，chain_id='A' 只对 A 链评分。

constraints.other: 可选链 ID；为空时自动选择第一条链。若提供则必须在两个 PDB 中都存在。
constraints.description: PDB/MMCIF chain identifier (typically a single character)

parameters.name: atom_type
parameters.description: 用于叠加的原子名称，例如 RNA 的 C1' 或蛋白质的 CA。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变用于 SVD 对齐与 RMSD 计算的原子集合，结果随之变化。
parameters.example: RNA 用 C1'  backbone；若改为 'P'，则 RMSD/TM-score 基于磷酸原子计算。

constraints.other: 用于叠加的原子名称，默认 C1'（RNA）。该原子必须在两条链中都存在，且对齐后至少要有 3 个原子。
constraints.description: Atom name used for superposition

score_structure_alignment.notes: 若两条链残基数不同，只取较短长度对齐；TM-score 按最长链长度归一化。

parameters.name: complex_pdb_filepath
parameters.description: RNA-蛋白质复合物 PDB 或 CIF 文件路径。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定所有原子坐标、可提取的链以及接触统计。
parameters.example: 更换为不同复合物会改变 interface_contacts、SASA 等全部指标。

constraints.other: RNA-蛋白质复合物文件路径，必须存在且可被 Bio.PDB.PDBParser/MMCIFParser 解析。
constraints.description: Path to RNA-protein complex PDB or CIF/MMCIF file

parameters.name: protein_chain_id
parameters.description: 蛋白质链 ID。
parameters.impact_on_result: 选择错误的链会导致蛋白原子集合为空或得到错误的界面统计。
parameters.example: protein_chain_id='A' 与 'B' 分别统计不同链与 RNA 的接触。

constraints.other: 蛋白质链 ID，默认 'A'；必须在复合物中存在且能解析出原子。
constraints.description: PDB/MMCIF chain identifier (typically a single character)

parameters.name: rna_chain_id
parameters.description: RNA 链 ID。
parameters.impact_on_result: 选择不同 RNA 链会改变界面接触与氢键/盐桥计数。
parameters.example: 复合物中 rna_chain_id='B' 与 'C' 会得到不同的 interface_contacts。

constraints.other: RNA 链 ID，默认 'B'；必须在复合物中存在且能解析出原子。
constraints.description: PDB/MMCIF chain identifier (typically a single character)

parameters.name: contact_cutoff
parameters.description: 判定界面接触的距离阈值（Å），范围 2.0–15.0。
parameters.impact_on_result: 阈值越大，识别到的残基对接触越多；阈值越小越严格。
parameters.example: contact_cutoff=3.0 时仅记录紧密接触；设为 8.0 会记录更多松散界面残基对。

constraints.other: 界面接触距离阈值（Å），Pydantic 层限制为 2.0–15.0。

analyze_rna_protein_interface.notes: 氢键按 2.5–3.5 Å 几何判据统计，盐桥按 ≤4.0 Å 统计； buried SASA 依赖可选的 freesasa 库。

parameters.name: protein_structure_path
parameters.description: 蛋白质 PDB 或 CIF 文件路径。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定可分析的表面残基集合与 SASA。
parameters.example: 不同蛋白结构会识别出不同的 hotspot_residues 集合。

constraints.other: 蛋白质结构文件路径，必须存在且可被 Bio.PDB.PDBParser/MMCIFParser 解析。
constraints.description: Path to protein PDB or CIF/MMCIF file

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: 要分析的链 ID；为空时使用第一条链。
parameters.impact_on_result: 选择不同链会改变暴露碱性残基集合与聚类结果。
parameters.example: chain_id='A' 与 chain_id='B' 会输出不同链的热点残基。

constraints.other: 可选蛋白链 ID；为空字符串时使用第一条链。
constraints.description: Protein chain ID; empty string means first chain

identify_protein_binding_hotspots.notes: 内部固定阈值：相对 SASA > 30%、仅 ARG/LYS/HIS、DBSCAN eps=10 Å/min_samples=2；这些阈值未在 Pydantic 输入中暴露。

parameters.name: cif_filepath
parameters.description: CIF/MMCIF 结构文件路径。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定可提取的残基与原子信息。
parameters.example: 不同 PDB entry 的 CIF 文件会提取出不同序列。

constraints.other: CIF/MMCIF 文件路径，必须存在且可被 Bio.PDB.MMCIFParser 解析；若缺少 _atom_site.B_iso_or_equiv 列，工具会自动注入占位值。
constraints.description: Path to CIF/MMCIF structure file

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: RNA 链 ID；为空时选择第一个含 O2' 原子的 RNA 链。
parameters.impact_on_result: 选择不同 RNA 链会改变返回的 sequence 与 residue_count。
parameters.example: chain_id='B' 提取 B 链序列；省略则默认取第一个 RNA 链。

constraints.other: 可选 RNA 链 ID；为空时选择第一个含 O2' 原子的 RNA 链。若提供则必须是 RNA 链。
constraints.description: PDB/MMCIF chain identifier (typically a single character)

extract_rna_sequence_from_cif.notes: 通过 O2' 原子检测 RNA；非标准核苷酸映射为 'N' 并在 warnings 中报告。

parameters.name: protein_structure_path
parameters.description: 目标蛋白 PDB 或 CIF 文件路径，对应 ODesign JSON 中的 ref_file。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定 ODesign 接收的参考结构路径。
parameters.example: 改为另一蛋白结构文件会让设计任务指向不同靶点。

constraints.other: 目标蛋白 PDB 或 CIF 文件路径，对应 ODesign JSON 中的 ref_file。该工具本身仅生成输入 JSON，不校验文件是否存在，但 ODesign 推理时需要 ref_file 有效。
constraints.description: Path to protein PDB or CIF/MMCIF file

parameters.name: protein_chain_id
parameters.description: 蛋白链 ID，例如 'C'。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定 proteinChain 的 sequence 字段格式为 'chain_id/1-length'。
parameters.example: protein_chain_id='C' 时序列字段为 'C/1-96'。

constraints.other: 蛋白链 ID，例如 'C'；会生成 proteinChain.sequence 字段 'chain_id/1-length'。工具本身仅按字符串拼接，不校验链是否真实存在。
constraints.description: PDB/MMCIF chain identifier (typically a single character)

parameters.name: protein_sequence_length
parameters.description: 蛋白序列长度。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定 proteinChain 覆盖的残基区间终点。

constraints.other: 蛋白序列长度，正整数；决定 proteinChain 覆盖的残基区间终点。工具本身不校验与真实蛋白长度是否一致。

parameters.name: hotspot_residues
parameters.description: 热点残基列表，格式如 'C/18,C/90,C/79,C/49'。
parameters.impact_on_result: 直接决定 ODesign 的 hotspot 字段，影响生成位点。
parameters.example: 将某个残基从列表移除，ODesign 会在剩余位点约束下生成 aptamer。

constraints.other: 热点残基列表，格式为 'chain/resnum,chain/resnum,...'，例如 'C/18,C/90,C/79,C/49'。
constraints.description: Comma-separated residues like 'C/18,C/90'

parameters.name: aptamer_length
parameters.description: 目标 RNA aptamer 长度（nt）。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定 rnaChain 的 sequence 字段 'length-length'，即生成长度。
parameters.example: aptamer_length=61 时生成 '61-61'；改为 30 则生成 '30-30'。

constraints.other: 目标 RNA aptamer 长度（nt），正整数；生成 rnaChain.sequence 字段 'length-length'。

parameters.name: output_prefix
parameters.description: 生成 JSON 文件名前缀；为空时使用 'odesign_aptamer_input'。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变保存文件名与 JSON 中 name 字段，不影响设计配置内容本身。
parameters.example: output_prefix='target_x' 会生成 target_x.json 且 name='target_x'。

constraints.other: 可选 JSON 文件名前缀；为空时使用 'odesign_aptamer_input'。
constraints.description: Optional output filename prefix

build_odesign_aptamer_input_json.notes: JSON 中的 center_method 固定为 'hotspot_center'；链类型固定为 proteinChain + rnaChain。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: CDS 序列文件路径；RNA 中的 U 会在服务端转为 T，长度不足 3 的倍数会被截断。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定所有密码子使用指标的基础数据。
parameters.example: 改变 CDS 会改变 CAI、Fop、CBI、Nc 等所有指标。

constraints.other: 文件必须存在且可读；内容为 FASTA 或纯文本；RNA 中的 U 会在服务端转为 T；只保留 ACGT；长度若不是 3 的倍数会被截断；归一化后长度必须至少为 9 nt（3 个密码子）。
constraints.description: Path to in-frame CDS sequence file (FASTA or plain text)

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: codonw_slim_service 的 /analyze/cds 端点地址。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响服务请求目标，不改变指标值（除非指向不同实现）。
parameters.example: 使用默认端点即可得到标准 CodonW 指标。

constraints.other: 必须是有效的 HTTP/HTTPS URL，默认指向 codonw_slim_service 的 /analyze/cds 端点。

parameters.name: genetic_code
parameters.description: CodonSeq 遗传密码索引：0=通用核基因，1=脊椎动物线粒体，…，7=棘皮动物线粒体。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变密码子到氨基酸的翻译规则，从而影响 CAI、CBI、Nc 等所有依赖氨基酸分组的指标。
parameters.example: 在线粒体密码中某些密码子含义改变，会导致 CAI 与通用码不同。

constraints.other: CodonSeq 遗传密码索引：0=通用核基因，1=脊椎动物线粒体，2=酵母线粒体，3=丝状真菌线粒体，4=昆虫/扁形动物线粒体，5=纤毛虫核基因，6=Euplotes 核基因，7=棘皮动物线粒体。

parameters.name: cai_ref
parameters.description: CAI 与 CBI 的参考集索引：0=大肠杆菌，1=枯草芽孢杆菌，2=酿酒酵母。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变最优/参考密码子集合，从而改变 CAI 与 CBI 数值。
parameters.example: 同一序列使用 cai_ref=2（酵母）通常与 cai_ref=0（大肠杆菌）得到不同 CAI。

constraints.other: CAI/CBI 参考集索引：0=大肠杆菌，1=枯草芽孢杆菌，2=酿酒酵母。
constraints.description: CAI/CBI reference set index

parameters.name: fop_ref
parameters.description: Fop 参考物种索引：0=大肠杆菌，1=枯草，2=盘基网柄菌，3=构巢曲霉，4=酿酒酵母，5=黑腹果蝇，6=秀丽隐杆线虫，7=粗糙脉孢菌。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定哪些密码子被视为最优密码子，从而改变 Fop 值。
parameters.example: fop_ref=0 与 fop_ref=4 对同一序列的最优密码子定义不同，Fop 结果不同。

constraints.other: Fop 参考物种索引：0=大肠杆菌，1=枯草芽孢杆菌，2=盘基网柄菌，3=构巢曲霉，4=酿酒酵母，5=黑腹果蝇，6=秀丽隐杆线虫，7=粗糙脉孢菌。
constraints.description: Fop reference species index

parameters.name: factor_in_rare
parameters.description: 是否将稀有密码子纳入 Fop 计算；为 True 时使用 (opt-rare)/total 形式。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变 Fop 计算公式，可能导致 Fop 值降低甚至出现 0。
parameters.example: 设为 True 时，若序列含稀有密码子，Fop 会比 False 时低。

constraints.other: 布尔值；为 True 时 Fop 计算使用 (opt-rare)/total 形式。

parameters.name: include_codon_tables
parameters.description: 是否在结果中包含 codon_usage 与 rscu 字典。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响返回的附表字段，不影响标量指标。
parameters.example: 设为 True 会返回每个密码子的使用次数与 RSCU 表。

constraints.other: 布尔值；为 True 时返回 codon_usage 与 rscu 字典。

parameters.name: include_dinucleotide
parameters.description: 是否返回按阅读框架的 dinucleotide 表。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅控制是否返回 dinuc 字段，不影响 CAI/Fop/CBI/Nc。
parameters.example: 设为 True 会得到 16 种二核苷酸在三帧中的比例表。

constraints.other: 布尔值；为 True 时返回按阅读框架的 dinucleotide 表。

parameters.name: include_aa_tables
parameters.description: 是否返回 aa_usage 与 raau 字典。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅控制是否返回氨基酸使用表，不影响标量指标。
parameters.example: 设为 True 会返回各氨基酸绝对与相对使用量。

constraints.other: 布尔值；为 True 时返回 aa_usage 与 raau 字典。

parameters.name: include_bases
parameters.description: 是否返回按密码子位置的碱基组成 bases DataFrame。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅控制是否返回 bases 字段，不影响标量指标。
parameters.example: 设为 True 会返回 GC1/GC2/GC3 等位置信息。

constraints.other: 布尔值；为 True 时返回按密码子位置的碱基组成 bases DataFrame。

analyze_cds_codon_metrics_with_codonw_sl.notes: 标量指标 CAI/Fop/CBI/Nc/hydropathy/aromaticity 始终返回；include 系列开关只影响可选大表。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: 包含两条序列的 workspace 文件：两个 FASTA record（sense 在前，antisense 在后）或两行纯序列。
parameters.impact_on_result: 决定输入的 siRNA sense/antisense 序列，是计算的唯一输入来源。
parameters.example:
>sense
GGGAAACCC
>antisense
GGGUUUCCC 会产生完全互补的双链结构。

constraints.other: must be an existing workspace file; contents should be two FASTA records or two plain sequence lines (sense first, antisense second)

parameters.name: temp_c
parameters.description: 折叠温度（摄氏度），对应上游 -T/--temp。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变温度会重新标度能量参数；温度降低通常使双链更稳定、MFE 更负，也可能改变预测结构。
parameters.example: 在 compute_sirna_duplex_binding_vienna 中对 73 nt tRNA-like 序列，temp_c=37 时 MFE=-31.50 kcal/mol；temp_c=25 时同一结构 MFE=-39.60 kcal/mol。

constraints.other: real-valued Celsius temperature; default 37.0. ViennaRNA rescales energy parameters to this temperature. No explicit upper/lower bound in RNAcofold.ggo, but physical energy parameter sets are only meaningful well above absolute zero.

parameters.name: dangles
parameters.description: 悬挂末端模型，对应上游 -d/--dangles，可选 0/1/2/3（LinearFold 仅支持 0/2）。
parameters.impact_on_result: dangles=0 忽略悬挂末端能量，通常会得到更高（更不稳定）的 MFE；dangles=2 为默认值，计入两侧悬挂末端能量。
parameters.example: 同一序列用 dangles=2 得到 MFE=-31.50 kcal/mol，dangles=0 得到 -25.50 kcal/mol。

constraints.other: 0=ignore dangling ends; 1=unpaired base participates in at most one dangling end; 2=add dangling energies on both sides (default); 3=coaxial stacking of adjacent helices in multi-loops (MFE only).

parameters.name: no_lp
parameters.description: 禁止 lonely pair（长度为 1 的螺旋），对应上游 --noLP。
parameters.impact_on_result: 开启后预测结构不再出现孤立碱基对，可能改变 MFE 结构和能量。
parameters.example: 对 GGGAAACCC，默认允许 lonely pair；开启 no_lp 后若唯一配对是孤立配对则会被移除，导致结构变为无配对。

parameters.name: no_gu
parameters.description: 禁止 G-U 配对，对应上游 --noGU。
parameters.impact_on_result: 关闭 G-U 配对会缩小可行结构空间，可能改变最优结构和能量，尤其对含 G/U 富集区的序列。
parameters.example: 某序列默认结构含 G-U  closing pair；开启 no_gu 后该螺旋末端必须由 G-C/A-U 封闭，结构可能重构。

parameters.name: no_closing_gu
parameters.description: 禁止螺旋末端的 G-U 配对，对应上游 --noClosingGU。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅影响螺旋 closing pair，比 no_gu 更温和，可能改变哪些发夹可以形成。
parameters.example: 一个发夹的 closing pair 为 G-U 时，开启后该发夹可能被替换为能量稍高的备选结构。

parameters.name: salt
parameters.description: 盐浓度（M），对应上游 --salt；源码中通过 RNAlib md.salt 或新版 CLI 传递。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变盐浓度会影响静电相互作用，从而改变双链稳定性和 MFE；不传入则使用上游默认值（约 1.021 M）。
parameters.example: 将 salt 从 1.0 M 降到 0.05 M 会使长双链的 MFE 略微变正（稳定性下降）。

constraints.other: salt concentration in molar (M); upstream default is 1.021 M. Must be non-negative.

parameters.name: no_tetra
parameters.description: 关闭三/四/六碱基发夹的特殊稳定化能量，对应上游 -4/--noTetra。
parameters.impact_on_result: 开启后特殊环的能量贡献被移除，含 GNRA 等稳定四环的结构能量会变差，可能改变预测结构。
parameters.example: 含稳定四环的序列默认 MFE 较低；开启 no_tetra 后 MFE 可能升高数 kcal/mol。

parameters.name: energy_model
parameters.description: 能量模型索引，对应上游 --energyModel，用于人工字母表等罕见场景。
parameters.impact_on_result: 改变能量模型会替换默认的 RNA 能量参数，导致 MFE 和结构显著不同；日常 RNA 折叠不建议修改。
parameters.example: energy_model=1 使用 G-C 能量参数，energy_model=2 使用 A-U 能量参数，结果与默认 RNA 模型不同。

constraints.other: 1=use GC energy parameters; 2=use AU energy parameters. Only used for artificial alphabets.

parameters.name: nsp
parameters.description: 允许非标准碱基对，对应上游 --nsp。
parameters.impact_on_result: 加入如 '-GA' 后 GA/AG 对可作为配对，可能形成默认模型不允许的碱基对，改变结构。
parameters.example: nsp='-GA' 时，某段序列可能形成 GA 配对的发夹，而默认模型中为单链。

constraints.other: comma-separated list of additionally allowed pairs; if the first character is '-' then AB implies both AB and BA are allowed (e.g. '-GA' allows GA and AG pairs).

parameters.name: param_file
parameters.description: 自定义能量参数文件路径，对应上游 -P/--paramFile；可传 'DNA' 加载 DNA 参数。
parameters.impact_on_result: 替换能量参数集会改变所有能量计算，从而改变 MFE 结构和数值。
parameters.example: param_file='DNA' 时使用 DNA 热力学参数，预测的 RNA 结构能量与默认 RNA 参数不同。

constraints.other: path to a custom energy parameter file, or the placeholder 'DNA' to load DNA parameters.

parameters.name: constraint
parameters.description: 硬约束点括号字符串，对应上游 RNAcofold -C。
parameters.impact_on_result: 强制某些位置必须配对或必须单链，会改变 MFE 结构和能量。
parameters.example: constraint='(((...)))' 会强制 sense 区形成发夹，阻止完全互补双链构型。

constraints.other: dot-bracket-like constraint string: '.' no constraint, '|' must pair, 'x' unpaired, '<'/'>' paired downstream/upstream, '(' ')' forced pair.

parameters.name: shape_file
parameters.description: SHAPE 反应性数据文件路径，对应上游 --shape。
parameters.impact_on_result: SHAPE 数据作为伪能量引入，偏好或惩罚某些区域的配对，改变结构和 MFE。
parameters.example: 高 SHAPE 反应性区域会被鼓励保持单链，可能导致原本形成双链的区域解旋。

constraints.other: path to a SHAPE reactivity data file.

parameters.name: shape_method
parameters.description: SHAPE 整合策略，对应上游 --shapeMethod，可选 D/Z/W。
parameters.impact_on_result: 不同方法对 SHAPE 反应性到配对概率的映射不同，影响约束强度。
parameters.example: shape_method='Z' 对高反应性值的惩罚通常比 'D' 更平滑。

constraints.other: D=Deigan et al 2009; Z=Zarringhalam et al 2012; W=Washietl et al 2012. Optional slope/intercept parameters may follow the letter.

parameters.name: concentrations
parameters.description: 是否计算浓度依赖的平衡浓度，对应上游 RNAcofold -c。
parameters.impact_on_result: 开启后会基于 conc_A/conc_B 计算 AB/AA/BB/A/B 的平衡浓度，结果中新增 equilibrium_concentrations。
parameters.example: conc_A=conc_B=1e-6 M 时，完全互补 siRNA 的 AB 二聚体占比可达约 0.48。

parameters.name: conc_a
parameters.description: 单体 A（sense）初始浓度（mol/L），concentrations=True 时必填。
parameters.impact_on_result: 浓度决定平衡分布；浓度越高越有利于二聚体形成。
parameters.example: 将 conc_a 从 1e-9 M 提高到 1e-6 M 会显著增加 AB 二聚体比例。

constraints.other: initial monomer concentration of strand A (sense) in mol/L; required when concentrations=True.

parameters.name: conc_b
parameters.description: 单体 B（antisense）初始浓度（mol/L），concentrations=True 时必填。
parameters.impact_on_result: 与 conc_a 共同决定平衡浓度。
parameters.example: conc_b=0 时不会形成 AB 二聚体。

constraints.other: initial monomer concentration of strand B (antisense) in mol/L; required when concentrations=True.

parameters.name: partfunc
parameters.description: 是否计算二聚体配分函数，对应上游 RNAcofold -p。
parameters.impact_on_result: 开启后返回 ensemble_free_energy；可评估 MFE 在整体系综中的代表性。
parameters.example: 完全互补双链 partfunc=True 时 frequency of mfe structure 可达 0.95。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: ViennaRNA 微服务 /sirna-duplex 端点地址。
parameters.impact_on_result: 仅改变请求目标，不影响算法本身。
parameters.example: 将 service_url 指向本地 8003 端口（默认）或集群内的备用实例。

parameters.name: --noPS

parameters.example: 微服务始终启用该选项以减少临时文件。

parameters.name: --all_pf
parameters.description: 上游 RNAcofold -a，计算 AA/BB 单体与 AB 二聚体的配分函数。
parameters.impact_on_result: 未在 wrapper 暴露；开启会得到更多二聚体/单体能量信息。
parameters.example: 若直接调用 CLI，-a 会输出 AA、BB、AB 的自由能。

constraints.other: argument is optional; 0 disables partition-function/dot-plot output, 1 enables it. The wrapper exposes this as a boolean flag.

parameters.name: --centroid
parameters.description: 上游 RNAcofold --centroid，计算 centroid 结构。
parameters.impact_on_result: 未暴露；开启会新增 centroid 结构输出。
parameters.example: 直接调用时 centroid 结构与 MFE 可能不同。

parameters.name: --gquad

parameters.name: --maxBPspan

parameters.example: maxBPspan=10 时只保留局部配对，长双链被拆散。

constraints.other: maximum base-pair span; -1 means no limit.

parameters.name: --batch
parameters.description: 上游 --batch，对多条序列使用同一约束文件。
parameters.impact_on_result: 未暴露；批量运行时影响约束应用方式。
parameters.example: 直接调用多序列折叠时开启。

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.description: 上游 -v，输出详细日志。

parameters.name: perc_identity

parameters.name: -gapopen

parameters.name: -penalty

parameters.name: -reward

parameters.name: -dust

parameters.name: -soft_masking

parameters.name: -max_hsps

parameters.example: Using a file with protein sequence 'MNDTEAI' returns a CDS such as AUGAACGAUACGGAGGCGAUC; changing the file to a longer protein changes the CDS length and structure accordingly.

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the LinearDesign microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects where the request is sent; the same endpoint logic is used, so the designed sequence is unchanged if the service version is identical.
parameters.example: Pointing service_url at a different host still produces the same CDS as long as the same LinearDesign binary and lambda/codon settings are used.

parameters.name: lambda_value
parameters.description: LinearDesign hyperparameter that balances minimum free energy (MFE) against codon adaptation index (CAI). In the CLI/binary it is passed as the first positional argument; the C++ engine multiplies this value by 100 internally, while verbose output divides it back by 100 for display. A value of 0.0 optimizes MFE only; larger values increasingly weight CAI in the joint objective.
parameters.impact_on_result: Larger lambda shifts optimization toward codon usage optimality (higher CAI). At 0.0 only MFE is optimized, usually yielding the most stable structure. As lambda increases, CAI generally rises; MFE may become less negative or remain similar depending on the protein and codon table, because the solver trades stability for codon preference.
parameters.example: For MNDTEAI with the human codon table, lambda=0.0 gives CAI 0.695 and MFE -1.10 kcal/mol (README example). For longer proteins, lambda=3.0 can raise CAI above 0.9 (e.g., testseq seq1: CAI 0.910, MFE -6.00 kcal/mol), but the exact MFE change depends on sequence length and available codon choices.

constraints.other: 支持小数；为0.0时仅优化MFE，越大越偏重CAI

parameters.name: codon_usage_path
parameters.description: Optional path to a codon-usage frequency table in CSV format. When omitted, the service uses external_repos/LinearDesign/codon_usage_freq_table_human.csv.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes which codons are considered optimal, directly affecting the generated CDS, its CAI score, and often its MFE. A species-specific table (e.g. yeast or mouse) produces a different CDS than the human table.
parameters.example: Running with codon_usage_freq_table_yeast.csv instead of the human table changes synonymous codon choices and typically lowers the human-CAI score while improving yeast-adapted codon usage.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在且可读的CSV文件；格式为三列（codon, amino_acid, relative_frequency），需覆盖64种密码子，参见 codon_usage_freq_table_human.csv

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Enables extra textual output from the LinearDesign binary (input protein echo, effective lambda, codon table path, runtime).
parameters.impact_on_result: Does not change the generated CDS, structure, MFE, or CAI; it only adds diagnostic lines to raw_output.
parameters.example: With verbose=False the raw output contains only sequence, structure, MFE and CAI; with verbose=True it additionally prints 'Input protein: ...' and runtime.

design_mrna_cds_with_lineardesign.notes: The wrapper exposes all runtime options of the upstream LinearDesign binary. There are no additional user-tunable hidden parameters; the CODING_WHEEL path is a compile-time constant.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path containing one or more protein sequences in FASTA or plain-text format.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the set of proteins designed. Each sequence is processed independently; the best successful result is saved as the primary artifact.
parameters.example: A FASTA with two proteins returns two CDS items; removing one header reduces the batch count and the reported best sequence.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的FASTA或纯文本文件，可包含多条蛋白序列；每条序列为单字母氨基酸

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the LinearDesign batch microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only changes the network target; results are identical for the same service version.
parameters.example: Switching to an equivalent batch service on another port does not alter the per-sequence CDS outputs.

parameters.name: lambda_value
parameters.description: Same LinearDesign lambda as the single-sequence tool; applied to every protein in the batch. LinearDesign hyperparameter that balances minimum free energy (MFE) against codon adaptation index (CAI). In the CLI/binary it is passed as the first positional argument; the C++ engine multiplies this value by 100 internally, while verbose output divides it back by 100 for display. A value of 0.0 optimizes MFE only; larger values increasingly weight CAI in the joint objective.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects the MFE/CAI trade-off for every sequence in the batch in the same direction: larger lambda shifts optimization toward codon usage optimality (higher CAI). At 0.0 only MFE is optimized, usually yielding the most stable structure. As lambda increases, CAI generally rises; MFE may become less negative or remain similar depending on the protein and codon table, because the solver trades stability for codon preference.
parameters.example: Applied across a batch: raising lambda from 0.0 to 2.0 generally raises CAI for all sequences, while MFE may become less negative or stay similar per sequence.

constraints.other: 支持小数；作用于batch中每一条序列，0.0仅优化MFE，越大越偏重CAI

parameters.name: codon_usage_path
parameters.description: Optional codon-usage table applied to every sequence in the batch.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes synonymous codon choices for all CDS candidates in the batch.
parameters.example: Using a mouse codon table makes the whole batch more mouse-adapted compared with the default human table.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在且可读的CSV文件；格式为三列（codon, amino_acid, relative_frequency），需覆盖64种密码子

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Enables verbose binary output for each per-sequence run.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only expands raw_output per item; does not change designed sequences.
parameters.example: verbose=True populates each item's raw_output with runtime and lambda diagnostics.

design_mrna_cds_batch_with_lineardesign.notes: Batch execution is implemented by looping over the single-sequence LinearDesign binary with shared lambda/codon/verbose settings. No extra batch-specific parameters exist.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path containing the input protein sequence. The wrapper extracts the first FASTA/plain-text sequence and sends it to the RNARL service.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the protein to be translated into a CDS. Sequences longer than 1308 amino acids are rejected by the service.
parameters.example: A file with the short protein 'MSTSK...' produces a CDS whose length is 3 times the protein length; changing to a different protein yields a different CDS.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的文本/FASTA文件，内容为一个蛋白序列；蛋白序列只能包含20种标准氨基酸及终止符*，且长度不得超过1308个残基

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the RNARL CDS generation microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects request routing when multiple service instances are deployed.
parameters.example: Switching the URL to a CPU-only instance gives the same argmax-generated CDS as a GPU instance.

parameters.name: model_type
parameters.description: RNARL trained variant. Supported values are Homo sapiens mRNA, Homo sapiens circular RNA, Arabidopsis thaliana mRNA, Escherichia coli mRNA, Penicillium chrysogenum mRNA, Chlamydomonas reinhardtii mRNA, Thermococcus kodakarensis KOD1 mRNA.
parameters.impact_on_result: Selects the species/RNA-type checkpoint, which changes the learned codon bias and the distribution of generated CDS sequences. The same protein yields different CDS for different model types.
parameters.example: Using 'Escherichia coli mRNA' instead of the default human checkpoint changes many synonymous codons to reflect E. coli codon usage.

parameters.name: checkpoint_path
parameters.description: Optional override for the RNARL actor checkpoint. When omitted, the service resolves checkpoints/RNARL/<model_type>.pt.
parameters.impact_on_result: Loading a different checkpoint changes the model weights and therefore the generated CDS. Useful for using a fine-tuned or retrained actor.
parameters.example: Supplying a newer homo_mrna.pt checkpoint trained on additional data can alter codon choices for the same protein.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在的RNARL actor checkpoint文件（.pt格式，包含可识别的state_dict）

parameters.name: esm2_model_path
parameters.description: Optional override for the local ESM-2 model directory used to encode the protein. Default is external_repos/RNARL/esm2_model_t33_650M_UR50D.
parameters.impact_on_result: Different ESM-2 weights produce different protein embeddings, which feed into the actor and can shift the generated CDS even with the same actor checkpoint.
parameters.example: Replacing the ESM-2 directory with a fine-tuned protein encoder changes the context vectors and may yield a different CDS.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在的本地ESM-2模型目录（例如 esm2_model_t33_650M_UR50D）

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Optional torch device string such as cuda:0 or cpu. The service defaults to CUDA if available, otherwise cpu.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects inference speed and hardware; with the same deterministic argmax decoding, the generated sequence should not change between cuda:0 and cpu in principle, though tiny floating-point differences are possible.
parameters.example: Setting device='cpu' forces CPU inference and may slow generation but should return the same CDS as 'cuda:0' for identical weights.

design_mrna_cds_with_rnarl.notes: RNARL generation is deterministic argmax decoding from the actor network logits; there is no exposed temperature or sampling seed. The service enforces a maximum protein length of 1308 residues.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path containing the protein sequence. The service requires at least 10 canonical amino acids (CDS >= 30 nt).
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the protein for which a CDS is generated. Non-canonical amino acids cause the upstream generate.py to raise an error.
parameters.example: A file containing the GFP fragment 'MVSKGEELFTGVVPILVELDGDVNGHKFSVSGEGEGDATYGKLTLKFICTTGKLPVPWPTLVTTLTYGVQCFSRYPDHMKQHDFFKSAMPEGYVQERTIF' yields a CDS output; truncating the protein shortens the CDS.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的文本/FASTA文件，内容为蛋白序列；需至少包含10个标准氨基酸（CDS≥30 nt），且不能含有非标准氨基酸

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the GEMORNA CDS microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only changes the request destination; identical service versions return identical sequences for the same input.
parameters.example: Using a local versus remote GEMORNA service makes no sequence difference if both load the same gemorna_cds.pt checkpoint.

design_mrna_cds_with_gemorna.notes: The GEMORNA CDS endpoint hard-codes --mode cds and the checkpoint checkpoints/gemorna_cds.pt. The upstream generate.py accepts --mode, --ckpt_path and --protein_seq, but these are not exposed by the wrapper. There is no exposed temperature, top-k or random-seed parameter.

parameters.name: utr_length
parameters.description: UTR length category for the 5'UTR generator. Allowed values are short, medium or long. The value is passed to the compiled UTR model's gen routine.
parameters.impact_on_result: Controls the target length of the generated 5'UTR. short produces the shortest sequence, long the longest, and medium an intermediate length; the exact nucleotide lengths are encoded in the model's compiled generation routine.
parameters.example: utr_length='short' returns a short 5'UTR sequence, while utr_length='long' returns a much longer 5'UTR candidate.

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the GEMORNA 5'UTR microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects network routing; the same model checkpoint and length category give the same result.
parameters.example: Changing service_url to another instance on port 8004 does not change the generated 5'UTR if the checkpoint is identical.

design_5utr_with_gemorna.notes: The service hard-codes --mode 5utr and checkpoint checkpoints/gemorna_5utr.pt. The length category is the only user-tunable design knob; no seed or sampling temperature is exposed.

parameters.name: utr_length
parameters.description: UTR length category for the 3'UTR generator. Allowed values are short, medium or long.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the target length of the generated 3'UTR in the same categorical way as the 5'UTR tool.
parameters.example: utr_length='long' yields a longer 3'UTR sequence than 'short' for the same model.

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the GEMORNA 3'UTR microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects request routing.
parameters.example: Using a remote service with the same checkpoint returns the same 3'UTR sequence.

design_3utr_with_gemorna.notes: Same architecture as the 5'UTR tool but using the gemorna_3utr.pt checkpoint. Only utr_length is exposed.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path containing the 5'UTR RNA sequence. T is converted to U before prediction.
parameters.impact_on_result: The sequence is the only model input; different 5'UTRs produce different predicted MRL values.
parameters.example: A file containing 'TACGTTTTGACCTTCGTTCATTTTG' returns a predicted MRL score; mutating the Kozak-like region usually changes the score.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的文本/FASTA文件，内容为RNA序列；仅允许A/C/G/U/T，长度至少10 nt，T会被转为U

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the GEMORNA 5'UTR MRL prediction microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects routing; identical models return identical scores.
parameters.example: Switching to another service instance does not change the MRL score for the same sequence.

predict_5utr_mrl_with_gemorna.notes: The service hard-codes the checkpoint checkpoints/5utr.pt and pads the tokenized sequence to 100 tokens. No structure, context or batch-size parameters are exposed.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path containing the 3'UTR RNA sequence. T is converted to U before prediction.
parameters.impact_on_result: The sequence is the only model input; different 3'UTRs yield different predicted stability scores.
parameters.example: A file with a long 3'UTR such as 'TGTCCCCGGGTCTTCCAACGGACTGGCGTTGCCCCGGTTCACTGGGGACTGCCCTTGGGGTCTCGCTCACCTTCAGCACACATTATCGGGAGCAGTGTCTTCCATAATGT' returns a stability score; adding a known destabilizing motif lowers the score.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的文本/FASTA文件，内容为RNA序列；仅允许A/C/G/U/T，长度至少10 nt，T会被转为U

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the GEMORNA 3'UTR stability prediction microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects request routing.
parameters.example: Two equivalent service instances return the same stability score for the same 3'UTR.

predict_3utr_stability_with_gemorna.notes: The service hard-codes checkpoints/3utr.pt. The CNN predictor is fully deterministic; no temperature or sampling parameters exist.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path containing the RNA sequence. Non-ACGU characters are removed and T is converted to U.
parameters.impact_on_result: The sequence drives RNA-FM embeddings, ViennaRNA folding and the final degradation profile. If the sequence exceeds 512 nt the wrapper returns a truncated zero-value result without calling the service.
parameters.example: A 200-nt CDS fragment returns per-nucleotide reactivity, deg_Mg_pH10 and deg_Mg_50C profiles; a 600-nt input is truncated to the first 512 nt and marked truncated=true.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的文本/FASTA文件，内容为RNA序列；仅允许A/C/G/U/T，T转U；序列超过512 nt会被wrapper截断后再送入服务

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the RNASTOP stability microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects routing.
parameters.example: Pointing to a different RNASTOP service instance does not change predictions if the same checkpoint is loaded.

parameters.name: structure
parameters.description: Optional secondary structure in dot-bracket notation. Must be the same length as the normalized sequence. If omitted, the service folds the sequence with ViennaRNA.
parameters.impact_on_result: Directly changes the structure adjacency and base-pair probability features fed into RNASTOP, which can substantially change the predicted degradation scores.
parameters.example: Providing a fully unpaired structure '....' for a sequence instead of its ViennaRNA MFE hairpin structure lowers structural-feature magnitudes and shifts the stability score.

constraints.other: 可选，点括号二级结构；长度必须与归一化后的RNA序列长度一致

parameters.name: loop_type
parameters.description: Optional loop-type annotation string in the OpenVaccine alphabet (S/M/I/H/B/E). Must match sequence length. If omitted, it is derived from the structure with RNA.db_to_element_string or a fallback S/E string.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes the loop embedding tensor; altered loop annotations shift the predicted reactivity and degradation profiles.
parameters.example: Annotating a region as 'H' (hairpin) instead of the derived 'S' (stem) changes the loop-token input and can raise or lower the local deg_Mg_50C prediction.

constraints.other: 可选，OpenVaccine环型注释；长度必须与序列长度一致；默认由ViennaRNA结构推导得到S/M/I/H/B/E

parameters.name: checkpoint_path
parameters.description: Optional override for the RNASTOP checkpoint. Default resolves to external_repos/RNASTOP/models/best_model_weights or best_model_weights_withoutDNABERT.
parameters.impact_on_result: Switching checkpoints changes model weights and therefore all predicted values. A checkpoint whose name contains 'withoutDNABERT' disables the DNABERT branch.
parameters.example: Using best_model_weights_withoutDNABERT gives a different overall_stability than the default best_model_weights because the DNABERT branch is omitted.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在的RNASTOP checkpoint文件；torch.load可加载；名称含 withoutdnabert 表示禁用DNABERT，含 withoutstrloopdnabert 不被本端点支持

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Optional torch device string such as cuda:0 or cpu. Default is CUDA if available, otherwise cpu.
parameters.impact_on_result: Mainly affects speed. In deterministic inference the numerical predictions should be the same across devices, though minor floating-point differences are possible.
parameters.example: device='cpu' slows inference for long sequences but returns the same profile as 'cuda:0' in most cases.

parameters.name: rnafm_model_path
parameters.description: Hidden service parameter not exposed by the wrapper. Default resolves to external_repos/RNASTOP/RNA-FM-main/pretrained/RNA-FM_pretrained.pth.
parameters.impact_on_result: Different RNA-FM weights change the sequence embeddings that RNASTOP consumes, altering predicted reactivity and degradation scores.
parameters.example: Replacing the default RNA-FM checkpoint with a retrained .pth file changes the overall_stability score for the same input sequence.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在的RNA-FM预训练权重文件（.pth）

parameters.name: dnabert_model_path
parameters.description: Hidden service parameter not exposed by the wrapper. Default resolves to external_repos/RNASTOP/DNABERT6 or scripts/DNABERT6.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only used when the selected checkpoint includes DNABERT. A different DNABERT model changes the DNA-language-model embeddings and can shift predictions.
parameters.example: Loading a fine-tuned DNABERT6 directory while using the default checkpoint changes the fused features and the resulting stability score.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在的DNABERT模型目录（含config.json与model.safetensors或pytorch_model.bin）

predict_mrna_stability_with_rnastop.notes: The wrapper truncates inputs longer than 512 nt locally before contacting the service. The service computes structure/loop features with ViennaRNA when they are not supplied, and supports both DNABERT and non-DNABERT checkpoints.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Workspace file path to the input FASTA file. For existing mode it is typically the reference viral genome; for predesign mode it is a multi-virus FASTA.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the target sequence(s) from which siRNAs/gRNAs are designed. An invalid path causes an immediate error.
parameters.example: Using test/genome.fa designs siRNAs against that reference genome; swapping to a different viral genome changes all candidate sequences.

constraints.other: 必须指向存在且可读的输入FASTA文件；existing模式为参考病毒基因组（单条或多条），predesign模式为多条现有病毒序列的多FASTA

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the Evitar microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only changes the network target.
parameters.example: A remote Evitar service with the same Evitar.pl version returns the same candidates as the local service.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Evitar execution mode. Allowed values: existing (single/few-virus design) or predesign (future-virus design across multiple strains/viruses).
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes the entire pipeline: existing mode runs predictsiRNA/portableRNAxs on a reference and optionally filters by strains; predesign mode builds a cross-strain coverage table and applies SGAR/greedy selection.
parameters.example: mode='predesign' with test/exist_viruses.fa returns a panel of siRNAs intended to cover multiple related viruses, whereas mode='existing' returns siRNAs against a single genome.

parameters.name: predict
parameters.description: Prediction/design algorithm. Allowed values: predsi, rnaxs, CRISPR, multifapredsi. CRISPR requires R on the server. multifapredsi is only valid in predesign mode.
parameters.impact_on_result: Selects the underlying scoring/design engine: predsi uses a GPP-like siRNA predictor, rnaxs uses RNAxs, CRISPR invokes the Cas13 R script, and multifapredsi runs a multi-FA variant of predsi.
parameters.example: predict='CRISPR' returns Cas13 guide RNAs instead of classical siRNAs and requires the Cas13 R script.

constraints.other: multifapredsi仅在predesign模式下可用；CRISPR需要服务器安装R（≥3.4）

parameters.name: strains_path
parameters.description: FASTA file of viral strain sequences. In existing mode it is used for cross-strain coverage; in predesign mode, if provided, it replaces the input file as the multi-strain input.
parameters.impact_on_result: Adds strain-variation constraints. The output siRNAs are filtered or selected to cover the strains in this file.
parameters.example: Providing test/strains.fa in existing mode removes siRNAs that fail to match the supplied strain sequences.

constraints.other: 可选，必须指向存在的病毒株FASTA文件；existing模式下用于跨株覆盖，predesign模式下若提供则替代input文件

parameters.name: off_target
parameters.description: Enables Evitar off-target evaluation against the transcriptome and 3'UTR FASTA files.
parameters.impact_on_result: When true, every candidate siRNA is scored for perfect-match, imperfect-match and miRNA-like off-target effects; candidates with high off-target scores are penalized or removed.
parameters.example: Enabling off_target with lung transcriptome and 3'UTR files filters out siRNAs that hit many human transcripts, reducing the result count.

constraints.other: 布尔开关；开启后必须同时提供p3utr_path与transcriptome_path才能运行完整off-target评估

parameters.name: ncores
parameters.description: Number of threads passed to Evitar. In existing mode it controls dividefa/select_siRNA parallelism; in predesign mode it controls the Perl threads worker pool.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects runtime and memory usage; with the same random seeding (none is exposed), the candidate set should be identical regardless of ncores.
parameters.example: ncores=8 speeds up strain processing in existing mode compared with ncores=1.

constraints.other: 整数线程数；README默认1

parameters.name: p3utr_path
parameters.description: FASTA file of 3'UTR regions used for miRNA-like off-target evaluation.
parameters.impact_on_result: Required input for off-target analysis; a different 3'UTR database changes the miRNA-like off-target scores and the filtered candidate list.
parameters.example: Using GenomeData/utrs.fa instead of a shorter custom 3'UTR set changes the number of seed matches reported.

constraints.other: 可选，off-target评估所需的3'UTR FASTA文件；开启off_target时必填

parameters.name: transcriptome_path
parameters.description: FASTA file of the transcriptome used for perfect/imperfect off-target evaluation.
parameters.impact_on_result: Required input for off-target analysis; the choice of transcriptome (e.g. RefSeq vs Ensembl) changes the off-target counts.
parameters.example: Using GenomeData/transcripts.fa evaluates all human transcripts, while a tissue-specific transcriptome returns fewer off-target hits.

constraints.other: 可选，off-target评估所需的转录组FASTA文件；开启off_target时必填

parameters.name: weight_path
parameters.description: Gene-weight file for tissue-specific off-target scoring. Format: ENSEMBL ID, Gene Symbol, weight.
parameters.impact_on_result: Weights off-target hits by tissue expression; high-weight genes penalize a candidate more than low-weight genes.
parameters.example: Using GenomeData/weightedgene/Lung.txt makes lung-expressed off-target genes count more in the final score than genes expressed only in testis.

constraints.other: 可选，组织特异性基因权重文件；格式为三列（ENSEMBL ID, Gene Symbol, weight），带单列标题行

parameters.name: sumtype
parameters.description: Selection algorithm for predesign mode. Allowed values: SGAR or greedy. If omitted, upstream defaults to SGAR.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes how the final cross-strain panel is assembled. SGAR uses a set-cover-like greedy algorithm; greedy uses the GAR algorithm. Different algorithms can yield different panels for the same input.
parameters.example: sumtype='greedy' with repeatnum=1 returns a smaller, greedily selected panel than the default SGAR behavior.

constraints.other: 仅在predesign模式下使用；默认SGAR

parameters.name: limitnum
parameters.description: Maximum number of siRNAs/Cas13 gRNAs to output in predesign mode. The Evitar.pl code initializes this to 50; the README documents 30. The wrapper passes None to use the upstream default.
parameters.impact_on_result: Caps the size of the final selected collection. A larger value returns more candidates; a smaller value keeps only the top-scoring ones.
parameters.example: limitnum=10 returns at most 10 siRNAs, while limitnum=100 returns a much larger panel.

constraints.other: 整数；README默认30，Evitar.pl内部默认50

parameters.name: repeatnum
parameters.description: Multi-siRNA penalty factor for predesign mode. The Evitar.pl code initializes this to 2; the README documents 3. The wrapper passes None to use the upstream default.
parameters.impact_on_result: Controls the redundancy penalty in SGAR/greedy selection. Higher values discourage selecting siRNAs that cover the same strains, promoting broader coverage.
parameters.example: repeatnum=1 behaves like conventional greedy selection; repeatnum=5 strongly penalizes redundant coverage.

constraints.other: 整数；README默认3，Evitar.pl内部默认2；设为1并配合sumtype=greedy即传统greedy

parameters.name: pmcuff
parameters.description: Perfect-match off-target cutoff. Default upstream value is 1. Candidates with perfect-match off-target count >= pmcuff are removed.
parameters.impact_on_result: Tightening this cutoff removes more siRNAs that perfectly match the transcriptome; loosening it keeps more candidates.
parameters.example: pmcuff=0 removes any siRNA with at least one perfect off-target match, while pmcuff=5 keeps siRNAs with up to four perfect matches.

constraints.other: 整数，perfect-match off-target cutoff；README默认1

parameters.name: umcuff
parameters.description: Imperfect-match off-target score cutoff. Default upstream value is 20.
parameters.impact_on_result: Lower values enforce stricter imperfect-match filtering; higher values allow more imperfect off-targets.
parameters.example: umcuff=10 removes siRNAs with imperfect-match scores above 10, producing a more specific panel than the default 20.

constraints.other: 浮点数，imperfect-match off-target cutoff；README默认20

parameters.name: mircuff
parameters.description: miRNA-like off-target score cutoff. Default upstream value is 20000.
parameters.impact_on_result: Controls filtering based on seed-region matches in 3'UTRs. Lower values remove more siRNAs with miRNA-like off-target potential.
parameters.example: mircuff=10000 makes the filter stricter than the default 20000, potentially reducing result count.

constraints.other: 浮点数，miRNA-like off-target cutoff；README默认20000

parameters.name: maxgc
parameters.description: Maximal GC-content cutoff for siRNA prediction. Default upstream value is 0.6.
parameters.impact_on_result: Candidates with GC content above this threshold are discarded. Lowering maxgc removes high-GC siRNAs; raising it allows more AT-rich or GC-rich candidates depending on the other bounds.
parameters.example: maxgc=0.5 removes siRNAs whose GC fraction exceeds 0.5, narrowing the candidate pool.

constraints.other: 浮点数，最大GC含量；README默认0.6

parameters.name: mingc
parameters.description: Minimal GC-content cutoff for siRNA prediction. Default upstream value is 0.25.
parameters.impact_on_result: Candidates with GC content below this threshold are discarded. Raising mingc removes very AT-rich siRNAs.
parameters.example: mingc=0.35 removes low-GC candidates, keeping only siRNAs with at least 35% GC.

constraints.other: 浮点数，最小GC含量；README默认0.25

parameters.name: middlegc
parameters.description: Suboptimal GC-content threshold. Default upstream value is 0.55. GC content between middlegc and maxgc is considered suboptimal and receives a reduced score.
parameters.impact_on_result: Narrows the 'optimal' GC range. Raising middlegc makes fewer candidates count as fully optimal.
parameters.example: middlegc=0.50 classifies GC contents 0.50-0.55 as suboptimal, whereas the default 0.55 would have treated them as optimal.

constraints.other: 浮点数，次优GC阈值；README默认0.55

parameters.name: allow_path
parameters.description: Text file with one allowed siRNA sequence per line. These sequences are forced into the predesign output when SGARallowban is used.
parameters.impact_on_result: Guarantees that specific validated siRNAs appear in the final panel, potentially displacing purely algorithm-selected candidates.
parameters.example: Providing an experimentally validated siRNA in allow_path ensures it is included even if its in-silico score is not top-ranked.

constraints.other: 可选，指向存在的文本文件，每行一条允许输出的siRNA序列（无表头）

parameters.name: ban_path
parameters.description: Text file with one banned siRNA sequence per line. These sequences are excluded from the design output.
parameters.impact_on_result: Removes undesirable or previously failed siRNAs from the candidate set before selection.
parameters.example: Adding a toxic off-target siRNA to ban_path prevents it from appearing in the output.

constraints.other: 可选，指向存在的文本文件，每行一条需排除的siRNA序列（无表头）

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Hidden upstream parameter that is automatically set by the Evitar microservice to a workspace file in workspace/evitar_service/. Evitar.pl requires --output.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only changes where results are written; the candidate set is unaffected.
parameters.example: The service writes to evitar_<uuid>.txt; the wrapper copies this file into the workspace as evitar_result_<id>.txt.

constraints.other: 由微服务自动设置，指向workspace/evitar_service/下的.txt输出路径

parameters.name: temp
parameters.description: Hidden upstream parameter for the temporary working directory. The microservice overrides this with a per-request UUID-named subdirectory to avoid race conditions.
parameters.impact_on_result: Does not change the result; only affects intermediate file placement and safe concurrent execution.
parameters.example: The service passes --temp .temp_<uuid>; two concurrent requests therefore do not overwrite each other's intermediate files.

constraints.other: 临时工作目录；微服务会覆盖为Evitar根目录下的UUID子目录，Evitar子脚本不接受绝对路径

parameters.name: offtargetperfect
parameters.description: Hidden upstream switch parsed by Evitar.pl. When present, it acts like off-target mode for the SGAR/greedy selection step even if --offtarget is not used.
parameters.impact_on_result: Influences whether SGAR adds transcriptome/3'UTR arguments to the selection command, but it does not run the full off-targetncore pipeline unless --offtarget is also set.
parameters.example: Adding --offtargetperfect without --offtarget would make SGAR expect transcriptome/3'UTR inputs and likely fail if they are missing.

constraints.other: 布尔开关，影响SGAR/greedy步骤是否拼接transcriptome/3'UTR参数，但不单独运行完整off-target流程

parameters.name: verifytype
parameters.description: Hidden upstream parameter parsed by Evitar.pl. Its value is initialized but not used in the documented execution path.
parameters.impact_on_result: No observable effect on the output in the current code path.
parameters.example: Changing verifytype to 'imperfect' does not alter the standard predsi/rnaxs results.

constraints.other: Evitar.pl解析但当前执行路径未使用

parameters.name: mutationrate
parameters.description: Hidden upstream parameter passed to select_siRNA via -m when strains are provided. It controls mutation-rate tolerance during strain-specific filtering.
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher values allow siRNAs to tolerate more mismatches across strains, increasing the number of cross-strain candidates.
parameters.example: mutationrate=0.1 keeps siRNAs that match 90% of strain positions, whereas the default strict selection removes anything that does not fully align.

constraints.other: 可选，株间突变率容限；传递给select_siRNA -m；值越大允许越多错配

parameters.name: parameterRNAxs
parameters.description: Hidden upstream parameter appended verbatim to the portableRNAxs command when predict='rnaxs'.
parameters.impact_on_result: Allows low-level tuning of the RNAxs algorithm (e.g. energy window, accessibility settings) but requires knowledge of the portableRNAxs CLI.

constraints.other: 可选，字符串，直接附加到portableRNAxs命令行；需熟悉RNAxs参数

parameters.name: RNAplfold

constraints.other: 可选，字符串，作为-p参数传给predictsiRNA或portableRNAxs；用于覆盖RNAplfold窗口设置

design_sirna_with_evitar.notes: The wrapper passes through all documented Evitar CLI options. The Evitar.pl script additionally parses several undocumented/internal options (verifytype, offtargetperfect, mutationrate, parameterRNAxs, RNAplfold, offtargetwholematch, offtargetpartmatch, offtargetmirna, range); some are used in specialized paths while others appear unused. The output and temp paths are managed automatically by the microservice.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the sgRNA sequence (23 nt including NGG PAM). The wrapper reads the sequence from this file rather than accepting it inline.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the on-target sgRNA sequence used in the CRISOT-Score calculation. Changing the file changes the guide RNA and therefore the score.
parameters.example: If the file contains GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAAGGG versus GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAATGG, the returned CRISOT-Score will differ because positions 21-23 (PAM/protospacer end) change the position-specific feature sum.

constraints.other: 文件内容需为 23 nt 的 sgRNA 序列（含 NGG PAM），仅允许 A/C/G/T/U/N（U 会被归一化为 T）。
constraints.source: CRISOT/CRISOT.py score 方法 len==23 断言、CRISOT/README.md、crisot_service/main.py _normalize_crisot_sequence

parameters.name: target_sequence
parameters.description: Target DNA sequence (23 nt including NGG PAM) paired with the sgRNA. Both sequences are normalized to uppercase DNA before scoring.
parameters.impact_on_result: Directly drives the CRISOT-Score. The score is the sum of 20 position-specific interaction terms between the sgRNA and target; any mismatch changes the returned value.
parameters.example: For sgRNA GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAAGGG, target GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAAGGG gives a high score (~0.95) while target GAGTCCGAGGAGAAGACGAAGGG (mismatches at positions 11, 16-17) gives a lower score (~0.69).

constraints.other: 长度 23 nt，前 20 nt 为 protospacer（仅 A/C/G/T/U），后 3 nt 为 NGG PAM；U 归一化为 T。
constraints.source: CRISOT/CRISOT.py score 方法 len==23 断言、CRISOT/README.md (23-nt with NGG PAM)、crisot_service/main.py

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the CRISOT score microservice. Pure routing parameter for the wrapper.
parameters.impact_on_result: Does not change the mathematical score; only determines which service instance receives the request. A wrong URL will cause a request failure rather than a different score.
parameters.example: Changing service_url from the default localhost:8011 to another host returns the same score if the remote service uses the same CRISOT model files.

parameters.name: ref_genome
parameters.description: Optional reference genome path accepted by the microservice request model. Not exposed by the agent wrapper. It is passed to the CRISOT constructor but is not used during single-pair scoring.
parameters.impact_on_result: For a single sgRNA-target pair, ref_genome has no effect on the returned CRISOT-Score because single_score_ only uses the pre-trained feature weights. It would affect service-side model caching only.
parameters.example: Passing data/test_genome.fa versus hg38.fa produces identical CRISOT-Score values for the same sgRNA-target pair.

constraints.other: 可选的参考基因组文件路径；单条评分时不影响结果，仅影响服务端模型缓存键。

score_crispr_off_target_with_crisot.notes: CRISOT-Score is a deterministic position-wise sum over 20 nt (excluding the PAM) using pre-trained parameters from crisot_score_param.pkl, clipped to [0, 1]. The wrapper enforces 23-nt normalization and U->T conversion.

parameters.name: csv_filepath
parameters.description: Path to a CSV file containing one sgRNA and one off-target DNA sequence per row. The on-target row must be first.
parameters.impact_on_result: Provides all sgRNA-target pairs used to compute CRISOT-Spec. Adding high-scoring off-target rows lowers specificity; removing them raises it.
parameters.example: A CSV with only the perfect-match on-target row returns CRISOT-Spec = 1.0, while the same CSV with many high-scoring off-target rows returns a lower value.

constraints.other: CSV 文件需存在，包含 on_item/off_item 两列，且第一行为 on-target 序列。

parameters.name: on_item
parameters.description: Name of the CSV column that holds the sgRNA/on-target sequences.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects column lookup. An incorrect name causes a missing-column error; otherwise the computed CRISOT-Spec is unchanged.
parameters.example: If the CSV header is 'sgRNA' instead of 'On', setting on_item='sgRNA' is required or the call fails.

constraints.other: CSV 列名字符串，默认 'On'。

parameters.name: off_item
parameters.description: Name of the CSV column that holds the off-target DNA sequences.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects column lookup. An incorrect name causes a missing-column error.
parameters.example: If the CSV header is 'target' instead of 'Off', set off_item='target'.

constraints.other: CSV 列名字符串，默认 'Off'。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the CRISOT spec microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only; does not alter the specificity value.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Optional upstream parameter in crisot_modules.CRISOT.spec that reorders rows so the matching target appears first. Not exposed by the wrapper or microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: If provided and matched, it guarantees the selected sequence is treated as the on-target. Because the wrapper already expects the on-target in the first row, changing it is usually unnecessary.
parameters.example: If several rows share the same sgRNA and the true target is not first, setting target could change which row is used as the on-target reference.

constraints.other: 可选的 23 nt 目标序列；若提供，必须能在 off-target 列中匹配到。
constraints.source: CRISOT/crisot_modules.py spec 方法 len(target)==23 断言

calculate_crispr_specificity_with_crisot.notes: CRISOT-Spec aggregates CRISOT-Score values into four score bins and computes 10 / (10 + weighted_sum). It is deterministic given the input CSV.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the sgRNA sequence (23 nt with NGG PAM).
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the guide RNA whose genome-wide off-targets are searched. A different guide yields a different off-target set and CRISOT-Spec.
parameters.example: Searching with GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAAGGG versus GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAATGG will match different genomic loci.

constraints.other: 文件内容需为 23 nt 的 sgRNA 序列（含 NGG PAM），仅允许 A/C/G/T/U/N。
constraints.source: CRISOT/CRISOT.py off_spec 方法 len==23 断言、CRISOT/README.md

parameters.name: target_sequence
parameters.description: On-target DNA sequence (23 nt with NGG PAM) used to label the intended site in the Cas-OFFinder output.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines which search result is treated as the on-target. If the target does not appear in the Cas-OFFinder output, the code appends it manually so specificity can still be computed.
parameters.example: Swapping target_sequence to a different 23-mer changes which returned site is shown first and counted as on-target.

constraints.other: 长度 23 nt，前 20 nt 为 protospacer，后 3 nt 为 NGG PAM。
constraints.source: CRISOT/CRISOT.py off_spec 方法 len==23 断言、CRISOT/README.md

parameters.name: genome_path
parameters.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file used by Cas-OFFinder.
parameters.impact_on_result: Directly determines the sequence space searched. A larger or different genome can reveal more off-targets and lower CRISOT-Spec; a small test genome gives fewer off-targets and higher specificity.
parameters.example: Using hg38.fa generally returns more off-targets and a lower CRISOT-Spec than using CRISOT/data/test_genome.fa.

constraints.other: 参考基因组 FASTA 文件路径，必须存在。

parameters.name: mismatches
parameters.description: Cas-OFFinder mismatch tolerance (allowed range 0-10). Higher values allow more mismatched off-target sites to be reported.
parameters.impact_on_result: Increasing mismatches expands the off-target set, which tends to lower CRISOT-Spec because more potential off-targets are scored. Decreasing mismatches trims distant matches and can raise specificity.
parameters.example: mismatches=3 typically returns only highly similar off-targets and a higher CRISOT-Spec than mismatches=6 for the same guide.

constraints.other: Cas-OFFinder 错配容忍度，默认 6。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Cas-OFFinder device flag. 'C' means CPU; 'G0' means the first GPU. Passed to the Cas-OFFinder binary.
parameters.impact_on_result: Assuming Cas-OFFinder is deterministic, device affects runtime and hardware requirements, not the set of reported off-targets or CRISOT-Spec. An unavailable device causes a failure.
parameters.example: device='C' on a GPU-only Cas-OFFinder build may fail; device='G0' uses GPU acceleration.

constraints.other: Cas-OFFinder 设备标识，例如 'C'（CPU）或 'G0'（第一块 GPU）。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the CRISOT off-spec microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.

parameters.name: offtar_search
parameters.description: Optional upstream shell script path passed to CasoffinderSpec_ in crisot_modules.py. Not exposed by the wrapper.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changing the script changes how Cas-OFFinder is invoked (e.g., indexing strategy or genome location). A broken path causes the search to fail.
parameters.example: Using a wrapper script that adds bulge search parameters would change the reported off-target set, although the default script does not.

constraints.other: 可选的 Cas-OFFinder 调用脚本路径，默认 script/casoffinder_genome.sh。

search_crispr_off_targets_with_crisot.notes: This tool wraps Cas-OFFinder genome-wide search followed by CRISOT-Score/Spec. It requires the cas-offinder binary on PATH. The result includes an off-target count and a scored CSV artifact.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the target/guide sequence (23 nt with NGG PAM) to be optimized.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the wild-type sgRNA that CRISOT-Opti will try to improve by single-nucleotide mutations. A different seed yields a different optimization landscape.
parameters.example: Optimizing GAGTCCGAGCAGAAGAAGAAGGG versus AGGCTAGTCCGTTA... produces completely different candidate mutations.

constraints.other: 文件内容需为 23 nt 的待优化 guide/target 序列（含 NGG PAM）。
constraints.source: CRISOT/CRISOT.py opti 方法 len(tar)==23 断言、CRISOT/README.md

parameters.name: genome_path
parameters.description: Reference genome FASTA path for Cas-OFFinder during the genome-wide specificity evaluations of each mutant.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects the off-target landscape against which each mutant is evaluated, changing the best mutant and CRISOT-Spec gains.
parameters.example: Using a small test genome may report no off-targets and always return the wild type as best; using hg38 usually finds genuine specificity-improving mutants.

constraints.other: 参考基因组 FASTA 文件路径，必须存在。

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Minimum retained CRISOT-Score for mutated sgRNAs. Only mutants scoring above this value against the target are accepted.
parameters.impact_on_result: A higher threshold keeps only high-activity mutants and may reduce the number of accepted mutants (or return none). A lower threshold allows more mutants but may include ones with weaker on-target activity.
parameters.example: threshold=0.95 may reject mutants that would have been accepted at 0.8, possibly yielding 'Optimization unavailable' if no mutant qualifies.

constraints.other: 突变体保留的最低 CRISOT-Score，默认 0.8。

parameters.name: mismatches
parameters.description: Cas-OFFinder mismatch tolerance for the genome-wide off-target search performed for each mutant.
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher values expand the off-target set and can reduce the computed CRISOT-Spec for each mutant, changing the ranking of best mutants.
parameters.example: mismatches=6 may reveal off-targets that mismatches=3 misses, causing a mutant to look worse under the broader search.

constraints.other: Cas-OFFinder 错配容忍度，默认 6。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Cas-OFFinder device flag ('C' or 'G0').
parameters.impact_on_result: Hardware selector; does not change the optimization logic or results if Cas-OFFinder is deterministic.

constraints.other: Cas-OFFinder 设备标识，例如 'C' 或 'G0'。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the CRISOT optimization microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.

parameters.name: opti_type
parameters.description: Upstream parameter controlling which positions and nucleotides are mutated. None means all 20 positions x 3 alternative bases. Not exposed by the wrapper.
parameters.impact_on_result: Restricting opti_type to a subset of positions limits the search space and can miss the globally best mutant; allowing all positions gives the broadest search.
parameters.example: opti_type=range(10, 16) only mutates positions 10-15, so a beneficial mutation at position 18 would never be considered.

constraints.other: 可选的突变范围；None 表示 1-20 位全部突变，tuple/list/range 指定位置（1-indexed），DataFrame 需含 'Pos' 和 'nt' 列且 nt∈{A,C,G,T}。

parameters.example: A reference with high reads at a particular off-target would penalize mutants that still bind that sequence.

constraints.other: 可选参考 DataFrame，需包含 'Offtarget_Sequence' 和 'GUIDE-Seq Reads' 列。

The microservice returns the best mutant and a CSV of all evaluated mutants.
