parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the CRISOT-FP encoding microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.

parameters.name: feat_dict
parameters.description: Optional upstream feature dictionary in FP_Encode_df. 'default' loads crisot_fingerprint_encoding.pkl. Not exposed by the wrapper.
parameters.impact_on_result: A custom feature dictionary changes the values in the generated fingerprint matrix.
parameters.example: If a new molecular-dynamics run updates the encoding, loading the new feat_dict updates the fingerprint values.

constraints.other: 可选特征字典；默认 'default' 加载 crisot_fingerprint_encoding.pkl。

generate_crispr_fingerprint_with_crisot.notes: This tool returns the raw CRISOT-FP feature matrix (one row per protospacer position) for a single sgRNA-target pair, not a probability. It is deterministic given the sequences.

parameters.name: seed_sequence
parameters.description: Inline seed/wildtype sgRNA handle sequence (DNA or RNA letters). Exactly one of seed_sequence or filepath must be provided.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the starting sequence and the set of fixed positions. All designed candidates are mutations of this seed.
parameters.example: Changing the seed from the canonical 61-nt wildtype to a truncated 50-nt sequence changes the candidate length and fixed-position constraints.

constraints.other: DNA/RNA 序列，长度 40-120 nt，仅允许 A/C/G/T/U（U 归一化为 T）；位置 6/22/23/30/32 会被强制固定为 G/G/T/A/G；seed_sequence 与 filepath 必须且只能提供一个。

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the seed sgRNA handle sequence. Exactly one of seed_sequence or filepath must be provided.
parameters.impact_on_result: Same as seed_sequence: it determines the seed from which all candidates are derived.
parameters.example: A file with a different wildtype sequence produces a different set of designed candidates.

constraints.other: 包含种子序列的文件路径；内容约束同 seed_sequence（长度 40-120 nt，A/C/G/T/U）。

parameters.name: n_samples
parameters.description: Number of designed candidate sequences to generate (excluding the wild-type seed).
parameters.impact_on_result: Larger values request more candidates. If the constraints are too strict, the service may return fewer than requested with a note.
parameters.example: n_samples=50 attempts to produce 50 mutants; n_samples=1 attempts to produce a single best mutant.

constraints.other: 生成候选数量（不含野生型），默认 10。

parameters.name: mutation_number
parameters.description: Maximum number of mutations allowed relative to the seed sequence (range 1-40).
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher values permit more divergent candidates; lower values keep candidates closer to the wild type. In the microservice, if mutation_number > 10 the implementation switches from MCMC to naive sampling for speed.
parameters.example: mutation_number=5 yields candidates with at most 5 differences from the seed, while mutation_number=22 allows deep modifications.

constraints.other: 相对种子序列的最大突变数，默认 22；若大于 10，服务会自动切换到 naive 采样模式。

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: For mcmc mode: MCMC annealing temperature controlling acceptance of structure-distance-increasing mutations (defaults to 20.0). For naive mode: transformer sampling temperature (defaults to 1.0).
parameters.impact_on_result: In mcmc mode, higher temperature accepts more structure-distance-increasing moves, increasing exploration and sequence diversity. Lower temperature makes the walk more greedy. In naive mode, higher temperature increases randomness of model-generated tokens.
parameters.example: temperature=100 in mcmc mode may accept candidates with larger structure distances, while temperature=1 stays near low-distance regions.

constraints.other: mcmc 模式默认 20.0，naive 模式默认 1.0；必须大于 0。
constraints.source: sgrna_design/sample.py --temperature 默认 20、sgrna_design/naive_sample.py --temperature 默认 1、sgrna_design_service/main.py (gt=0, le=100)

parameters.name: max_length
parameters.description: Optional target sequence length for naive mode. It overrides the auto-computed max_new_tokens.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects naive sampling. It controls how many tokens the model generates beyond the prompt. A smaller max_length yields shorter candidates; a larger one may exceed model position limits.
parameters.example: If the seed is 61 nt and max_length=50, generated candidates are truncated/padded to 50 nt, which can violate the canonical sgRNA handle length.

constraints.other: naive 模式下目标序列长度，覆盖自动计算的 max_new_tokens。

parameters.name: max_overlap
parameters.description: Maximum longest-common-substring overlap allowed among accepted candidate sequences (range 1-60).
parameters.impact_on_result: Lower values enforce higher diversity among candidates but make it harder to satisfy n_samples. Higher values relax diversity and may return more similar sequences.
parameters.example: max_overlap=5 produces very diverse candidates; max_overlap=50 may return candidates sharing long subsequences.

constraints.other: 候选序列间最长公共子串上限，默认 21；实际必须小于种子长度。

parameters.name: sampling_mode
parameters.description: Sampling strategy: 'mcmc' (original MCMC/annealing with ViennaRNA structure constraints) or 'naive' (direct GPT-2 model.generate sampling).
parameters.impact_on_result: mcmc uses structure-distance and neural-network scores in an annealing loop and requires ViennaRNA; it tends to preserve the canonical sgRNA handle structure. naive directly samples from the CRGPT model and is faster but less constrained by structure.
parameters.example: sampling_mode='naive' may generate candidates faster but with less control over RNA secondary structure compared to 'mcmc'.

constraints.other: mcmc 模式依赖 ViennaRNA；naive 模式直接调用 GPT-2 生成。

parameters.name: path_to_model
parameters.description: Optional model directory (relative to sgrna_design root or absolute path).
parameters.impact_on_result: Loading a different trained CRGPT model changes the neural-network scores and therefore which candidates are accepted.
parameters.example: Using crgen_small versus a custom fine-tuned model changes the nn_score values and the preferred sequences.

constraints.other: 可选模型目录路径（相对 sgrna_design 根目录或绝对路径）。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Optional torch device override such as 'cuda:0' or 'cpu'. Defaults to SGRNA_DESIGN_DEVICE env var or cuda:0 if available.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects inference speed and whether the call succeeds (CPU fallback if CUDA unavailable). Floating-point determinism is usually similar, but GPU/CPU may produce tiny numerical differences.
parameters.example: device='cpu' runs without a GPU but is slower; device='cuda:0' requires CUDA.

constraints.other: torch 设备，例如 'cuda:0' 或 'cpu'；未提供时取环境变量或自动检测。

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Optional output directory override for FASTA/JSON artifacts. Defaults to workspace/sgrna_design_service.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only changes where result files are written, not the designed sequences themselves.
parameters.example: output_dir='/tmp/my_run' writes artifacts to /tmp/my_run instead of the default workspace.

constraints.other: 可选输出目录，仅影响结果文件写入位置。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the sgRNA design microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.

design_sgrna_handle_with_crgpt.notes: The canonical seed is a 61-nt sgRNA handle. Fixed positions are enforced at indices 6, 22, 23, 30, 32 (0-based). MCMC mode requires ViennaRNA and uses a target secondary structure derived from Reis et al. Nat. Biotechnol. 2019. The microservice auto-relaxes pathological max_overlap values and falls back to random constrained mutations if the primary sampler cannot fill the quota.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: sgRNA handle sequence to score (DNA or RNA letters). It is normalized to uppercase DNA and fixed positions are enforced before scoring.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the per-token log-likelihood from the CRGPT model and the ViennaRNA structure metrics. Different sequences produce different nn_score, log_likelihood, structure_distance, and mfe values.
parameters.example: The canonical wildtype 61-nt sequence scores close to the model's training distribution; a randomized sequence of the same length typically gets a higher nn_score (worse) and larger structure_distance.

constraints.other: sgRNA handle 序列，DNA/RNA 字母 A/C/G/T/U；必须至少包含固定位置索引 6/22/23/30/32，位置会被强制固定为 G/G/T/A/G。

parameters.name: path_to_model
parameters.description: Optional model directory override.
parameters.impact_on_result: A different CRGPT model changes the nn_score and log_likelihood because the model weights differ.
parameters.example: Scoring the same sequence with crgen_small versus a fine-tuned model may return nn_score=2.1 versus nn_score=1.8.

constraints.other: 可选模型目录路径。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Optional torch device override such as 'cuda:0' or 'cpu'.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects runtime and availability. Tiny numerical differences between CPU and GPU are possible but usually negligible.

constraints.other: torch 设备，例如 'cuda:0' 或 'cpu'。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: REST endpoint of the sgRNA scoring microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.

score_sgrna_handle_with_crgpt.notes: The score is computed as nn_score = exp(loss) from the CRGPT causal language model, where lower values indicate higher model likelihood. log_likelihood is the negative cross-entropy. structure_distance and mfe come from ViennaRNA when available. constraint_mutation_count reports violations of fixed positions 6, 22, 23, 30, 32.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the RNA sequence (plain text or FASTA). The wrapper reads the sequence and sends it to the microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the RNA sequence whose 3D structure is predicted. Changing it predicts a different molecule entirely.
parameters.example: Changing from 'workspace/rna_1.fasta' with sequence GGCU to 'workspace/rna_2.fasta' with sequence AAAAA yields a different PDB.

constraints.other: 文件内容为 RNA 序列（纯文本或 FASTA），归一化后只保留 A/U/G/C，长度至少 1；T 会被转为 U。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the RhoFold microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects where the request is routed; does not change the predicted structure if the same service version is used.
parameters.example: Setting service_url to a remote GPU server endpoint returns the same model output (modulo hardware nondeterminism).

parameters.name: relax_steps
parameters.description: Number of Amber relaxation iterations applied to the unrelaxed structure. 0 skips relaxation.
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher values improve stereochemistry and local geometry (bond lengths, angles, clashes) but increase runtime and can slightly shift atom positions. The downstream PDB file switches from unrelaxed_model.pdb to relaxed_N_model.pdb when >0.
parameters.example: relax_steps=0 returns the raw neural-network output; relax_steps=1000 returns an energy-minimized structure with better local geometry but may take minutes longer.

constraints.other: 为 0 时跳过 Amber relaxation；大于 0 时生成 relaxed_N_model.pdb。

parameters.name: checkpoint_path
parameters.description: Path to a custom RhoFold checkpoint. If omitted, the service searches standard pretrained paths.
parameters.impact_on_result: Directly changes the trained weights used for inference, altering every predicted coordinate and confidence score.
parameters.example: Using a fine-tuned checkpoint on riboswitches instead of the default RhoFold_pretrained.pt may give higher pLDDT for riboswitch backbones.

constraints.other: 应为 RhoFold 预训练权重 .pt 文件；留空时服务在常见本地路径中查找。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Torch device string passed to upstream inference.py, e.g. 'cpu', 'cuda', 'cuda:0'.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes hardware and can affect speed. With the same deterministic settings results are numerically close across devices, but small floating-point differences may appear.
parameters.example: device='cpu' runs slowly on CPU; device='cuda:0' uses the first GPU and is much faster.

constraints.other: 可为 cpu 或 cuda:<GPU_index>；留空时由上游自动选择。

parameters.name: single_seq_pred
parameters.description: Microservice-only flag. If True, RhoFold uses only the input sequence (input_fas) as the MSA. If False, an A3M file is generated or supplied.
parameters.impact_on_result: False enables MSA-based modeling, which can improve accuracy for homologous RNAs but requires local BLAST databases (~900 GB) that are not deployed here. The project therefore defaults to single-sequence mode.
parameters.example: single_seq_pred=False with input_a3m_path set to a precomputed MSA can give a different structure than single-sequence mode for large conserved RNAs.

constraints.other: True 表示仅用输入序列作为 MSA；False 时需要提供 input_a3m_path 或本地 BLAST 数据库。

parameters.name: input_a3m_path
parameters.description: Microservice-only path to a precomputed A3M MSA file. Used only when single_seq_pred is False.
parameters.impact_on_result: Provides evolutionary covariance information; different MSAs lead to different predicted structures, especially for long RNAs.
parameters.example: Supplying an MSA built from 100 RNase P homologs changes the predicted tertiary fold compared with the single-sequence model.

constraints.other: 仅在 single_seq_pred=False 时使用；应为 A3M 格式的多序列比对文件。

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Subprocess timeout for one RhoFold run (microservice level).
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects whether the job is killed for exceeding time; does not change the scientific result when the job finishes.
parameters.example: timeout_seconds=300 may abort a very long sequence, while 7200 allows it to finish.

parameters.name: database_dpath / binary_dpath
parameters.description: Upstream-only paths to BLAST databases and BLAST binaries for MSA generation. Not exposed by the microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: If MSA mode were enabled, these paths determine which sequence databases are searched and therefore the contents of the MSA.
parameters.example: Pointing binary_dpath to a newer BLASTN binary does not alter the model, but pointing database_dpath to an updated RNAcentral release changes the MSA.

predict_rna_tertiary_structure_with_rhof.notes: Upstream inference.py defaults to relax_steps=1000, but the project wrapper defaults to 0 to reduce runtime. MSA-based prediction is supported upstream but disabled in this deployment because local BLAST databases are not installed.

parameters.name: pdb_filepath
parameters.description: Path to the input PDB or CIF structure file used as the structural template.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the backbone geometry to which the designed sequence must conform; different PDBs yield completely different sequences.
parameters.example: Using a PDB of the Tetrahymena ribozyme P4-P6 domain versus a tRNA PDB yields sequences specific to each scaffold.

constraints.other: 输入结构模板文件，后缀为 .pdb 或 .cif；RhoDesign util.load_structure 通过 biotite 读取。

parameters.name: secondary_structure_filepath
parameters.description: Path to a secondary-structure contact-map .npy file. If provided, the service switches to the with-2D RhoDesign mode.
parameters.impact_on_result: Enables the 2D-assisted checkpoint (ss_apexp_best.pth), which incorporates base-pairing constraints and usually improves recovery rate over the PDB-only mode.
parameters.example: Providing a contact map for a designed hairpin pushes the model toward sequences compatible with the target base pairs.

constraints.other: 可选的二级结构 contact map，必须为 .npy 格式；提供时切换为 with-2D 模式。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the RhoDesign microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only; no scientific effect if the same service version is used.
parameters.example: Switching to a different host running the same RhoDesign service returns the same sequence (modulo nondeterminism).

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature for the categorical sequence sampler. The upstream script defaults to 1e-5 for with-2D mode and 1.0 for without-2D mode; the wrapper fixes 1e-5 as default.
parameters.impact_on_result: Lower values (near 0) make sampling greedy, increasing sequence recovery and reproducibility but reducing diversity. Higher values (e.g. 1.0) increase exploration and may produce more diverse, lower-recovery sequences.
parameters.example: temperature=1e-5 on a tRNA scaffold typically recovers the native sequence; temperature=1.0 may return a different sequence with lower recovery.

constraints.other: 必须大于 0；with-2D 模式默认 1e-5，PDB-only 模式默认 1.0。越低越贪婪、恢复率越高。
constraints.source: external_repos/RhoDesign/src/inference.py -temp default=1e-5; external_repos/RhoDesign/src/inference_without2d.py -temp default=1; microservices/rhodesign_service/main.py temperature gt=0

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducible sampling. If omitted, the microservice generates a per-call random seed.
parameters.impact_on_result: Fixing the seed makes the generated sequence deterministic across runs. Different seeds give different sampled sequences from the same model distribution.
parameters.example: seed=42 and seed=43 on the same PDB usually produce two different sequences; rerunning with seed=42 reproduces the same sequence.

constraints.other: 随机种子，整数；留空时微服务自动生成一个种子。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: CUDA device index passed to the upstream RhoDesign script.
parameters.impact_on_result: Selects which GPU runs the model. Affects speed; results are numerically close across devices.
parameters.example: device=0 uses the first GPU; device=1 runs on the second GPU.

constraints.other: CUDA 设备索引，必须为非负整数。

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Subprocess timeout for one RhoDesign generation run.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects runtime limits, not the designed sequence when the job completes.
parameters.example: timeout_seconds=600 may kill a slow job on a very large RNA, while 3600 allows it to finish.

parameters.name: checkpoint_path (internal)
parameters.description: Hardcoded upstream model path selected automatically based on whether a secondary structure file is provided. Not exposed as a user parameter.
parameters.impact_on_result: The chosen checkpoint determines the trained weights; switching between with-2D and without-2D checkpoints changes the designed sequence distribution.
parameters.example: Running with a secondary-structure map selects ss_apexp_best.pth, which generally gives higher recovery on known RNAs than no_ss_apexp_best.pth.

design_rna_sequence_with_rhodesign.notes: The with-2D and without-2D modes use different upstream scripts (inference.py vs inference_without2d.py) and different checkpoints. The wrapper abstracts this choice by the presence or absence of secondary_structure_filepath.

parameters.name: pdb_filepath
parameters.description: Path to an RNA structure PDB file used as the conditioning structure.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the 3D scaffold; every sampled sequence is conditioned on this backbone geometry.
parameters.example: Swapping a riboswitch apo-state PDB for its ligand-bound PDB changes which sequences the diffusion model considers compatible.

constraints.other: 必须是包含 RNA 结构的 PDB 文件；微服务会将 HETATM 记录的修饰核苷（如 2MG/PSU）改写为 ATOM 标准 A/C/G/U。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the RiboDiffusion microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Pointing to a different replica of the same service does not change the sampled sequences.

parameters.name: n_samples
parameters.description: Number of sequences to sample for the input structure.
parameters.impact_on_result: More samples increase diversity and the chance of recovering the native sequence, but increase runtime linearly.
parameters.example: n_samples=1 returns one sequence; n_samples=10 returns ten distinct sequences ranked by recovery.

parameters.name: sampling_steps
parameters.description: Number of reverse-diffusion time steps used during sampling.
parameters.impact_on_result: More steps generally improve sequence quality and recovery but slow inference. Too few steps can produce noisy or invalid sequences.
parameters.example: sampling_steps=10 gives fast but low-quality samples; sampling_steps=200 gives slower, higher-quality samples for the same PDB.

parameters.name: cond_scale
parameters.description: Classifier-free guidance-style conditional scale. -1 disables guidance; values >=0 enable guidance (typical alternative 0.4).
parameters.impact_on_result: When >=0, the sampler amplifies the difference between conditional and unconditional predictions. This can strengthen adherence to the structural condition but may reduce diversity or push samples out of distribution.
parameters.example: cond_scale=0.4 often improves recovery over -1 on benchmark RNAs, while cond_scale=2.0 may produce over-confident but less natural sequences.

constraints.other: -1 禁用 classifier-free guidance；大于等于 0 时启用（典型值 0.4）。

parameters.name: dynamic_threshold
parameters.description: If True, clip predicted values adaptively during sampling based on a percentile of absolute predictions.
parameters.impact_on_result: Can stabilize very high-guidance sampling and reduce pathological outputs; may also dampen diversity.
parameters.example: Enabling dynamic_threshold with cond_scale=0.4 can prevent extreme logit values and yield more plausible sequences.

parameters.name: deterministic
parameters.description: If True, the upstream script sets a fixed random seed for reproducibility.
parameters.impact_on_result: True makes results reproducible across runs; False introduces randomness so the same inputs can return different sequences.
parameters.example: deterministic=False with n_samples=5 gives five stochastic sequences each run; deterministic=True reproduces the same set.

constraints.other: True 时上游固定随机种子以保证可复现。

parameters.name: checkpoint_name
parameters.description: Checkpoint basename without extension. Supported: 'exp_inf' and 'exp_inf_large'.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes the trained diffusion model weights and capacity. 'exp_inf_large' is expected to be a larger model with potentially higher recovery at higher computational cost.
parameters.example: checkpoint_name='exp_inf_large' may improve recovery on a Group I intron compared with 'exp_inf'.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Logical CUDA device index (sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for the subprocess).
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects GPU selection and speed; same-device determinism is preserved.
parameters.example: device=0 runs on GPU 0; device=2 runs on GPU 2.

constraints.other: 逻辑 CUDA 设备索引，通过 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 传入子进程。

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Subprocess timeout (microservice only).
parameters.impact_on_result: Runtime guard only.
parameters.example: A large RNA with n_samples=64 may need timeout_seconds=3600 instead of 7200.

parameters.name: config.eval.dynamic_thresholding_percentile
parameters.description: Upstream config parameter controlling the percentile used when dynamic_threshold is enabled.
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher percentiles clip less aggressively; lower percentiles clip more aggressively, smoothing extreme predictions.
parameters.example: dynamic_thresholding_percentile=0.99 is a milder clipping than 0.95.

constraints.other: 动态阈值百分位，仅在 dynamic_threshold=True 时生效。

design_rna_inverse_fold_with_ribodiffusi.notes: The microservice preprocesses PDB files to convert modified RNA residues (HETATM records such as 2MG, PSU) into canonical ATOM records because RiboDiffusion's parser only reads ATOM lines. This hidden preprocessing can change the effective sequence length.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the RNA sequence (plain text or FASTA). The wrapper reads the sequence text.
parameters.impact_on_result: The RNA sequence directly determines the encoded target tensor and therefore the binding probability.
parameters.example: Changing from a theophylline aptamer sequence to a random poly-A sequence of the same length strongly lowers the positive-class probability.

constraints.other: RNA 序列文件（纯文本或 FASTA），归一化后仅保留 A/U/G/C，长度至少 1；T 转 U。有效序列超过 500 nt 会被截断，不足则零填充。

parameters.name: smiles
parameters.description: Ligand SMILES string.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the molecular graph fed into the GCN branch; different ligands produce different scores for the same RNA.
parameters.example: For the TPP riboswitch, SMILES of thiamine pyrophosphate yields a high probability, while an unrelated small molecule yields a low probability.

constraints.other: 必须是被 RDKit Chem.MolFromSmiles 成功解析的有效 SMILES 字符串。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the RNAsmol microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Switching endpoints does not change the score if the same checkpoint is loaded.

parameters.name: checkpoint_path
parameters.description: Explicit path to a trained RNAsmol .pt checkpoint. Overrides auto-discovery.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes the trained model weights, directly altering probability_positive and predicted_label.
parameters.example: Using pdb_bothaug_molperturbation.pt versus robin_bothaug_netperturbation.pt changes the score because the models were trained on different data perturbations.

constraints.other: 可选的 RNAsmol .pt 检查点路径；提供时覆盖自动发现。

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Training dataset source hint for checkpoint auto-selection (e.g. 'pdb', 'robin').
parameters.impact_on_result: Guides the service to pick a checkpoint trained on the specified data source, which biases predictions toward that distribution.
parameters.example: dataset='robin' selects a Robin-trained checkpoint, which may score ROBIN benchmark ligands higher than dataset='pdb'.

constraints.other: 用于检查点自动匹配的数据集提示；对应 saved_model/ 下文件名前缀。

parameters.name: perturbation_type
parameters.description: Data-perturbation strategy hint for checkpoint auto-selection (e.g. 'molperturbation', 'netperturbation', 'rnaperturbation').
parameters.impact_on_result: Selects a checkpoint trained with the specified perturbation strategy, affecting robustness and score distribution.
parameters.example: perturbation_type='rnaperturbation' picks a checkpoint more robust to RNA sequence variation.

constraints.other: 用于检查点自动匹配的数据增强策略提示；对应 saved_model/*_{perturbation_type}.pt。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: PyTorch device string such as 'cuda:0' or 'cpu'. Falls back to RNASMOL_DEVICE env var or cuda:0.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines inference hardware. With the same weights the score is numerically identical; CPU fallback is slower.
parameters.example: device='cpu' works without a GPU but is slower for large batches.

parameters.name: target_len (internal padding length)
parameters.description: Fixed length to which the RNA sequence is padded or truncated in the microservice preprocessing. Not user exposed.
parameters.impact_on_result: Sequences longer than 500 are truncated, which can remove binding-relevant distal regions; shorter sequences are zero-padded.
parameters.example: A 600-nt RNA is truncated to 500 nt, potentially dropping a ligand-binding motif and lowering the score.

score_rna_ligand_binding_with_rnasmol.notes: RNAsmol is a binary classifier (MCNN_GCN). The output probability_positive is the softmax probability of class 1. The model was trained with different data augmentation strategies; checkpoint selection is therefore the strongest determinant of the score.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a file containing the RNA sequence (plain text or FASTA).
parameters.impact_on_result: The RNA sequence feeds RNA-FM and determines the RNA graph; changing it changes the affinity score.
parameters.example: A MALAT1 RNA fragment versus a scrambled control of the same length yields very different probability_positive values.

constraints.other: RNA 序列文件（纯文本或 FASTA），归一化后仅保留 A/U/G/C，长度至少 1；T 转 U。

parameters.name: smiles
parameters.description: Ligand SMILES string.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the molecular graph and conformer coordinates used by the GerNA model; different ligands score differently.
parameters.example: A known MALAT1 binder SMILES scores higher than a decoy molecule from the same molecular weight range.

constraints.other: 必须是被 RDKit Chem.MolFromSmiles 成功解析的有效 SMILES 字符串。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the GerNA-Bind microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Changing endpoints does not change the affinity score if the same model is loaded.

parameters.name: checkpoint_path
parameters.description: Explicit path to a GerNA-Bind affinity checkpoint.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes model weights; different checkpoints (e.g. Robin vs Biosensor) were trained on different datasets and produce different scores.
parameters.example: checkpoint_path=Model/Robin_random.pth versus Model/Biosensor_random.pth can swap a binder from positive to negative.

constraints.other: 可选的 GerNA-Bind 亲和力 .pth 检查点路径。

parameters.name: pdb_path
parameters.description: Optional precomputed RNA PDB structure. If omitted, the service calls the RhoFold microservice to generate one.
parameters.impact_on_result: The 3D coordinates (C4', N1, P atoms) are used as geometric features. A different PDB changes the spatial input and can shift the score, especially for structure-sensitive binders.
parameters.example: Providing an experimentally determined PDB instead of a RhoFold model may improve the score for a ligand that depends on a precise binding pocket.

constraints.other: 可选的预计算 RNA PDB；省略时自动调用 RhoFold 服务生成。

parameters.name: secondary_structure
parameters.description: Optional dot-bracket RNA secondary structure. If omitted, the service runs RNAfold.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the RNA base-pairing graph edge_index. Different folds change the message-passing features and the score.
parameters.example: Providing the native riboswitch fold instead of the RNAfold minimum-free-energy fold can increase the score for cognate ligands.

constraints.other: 可选的 dot-bracket 二级结构；省略时自动运行 RNAfold。

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Torch device such as 'cuda:0' or 'cpu'. Falls back to GERNABIND_DEVICE env var.
parameters.impact_on_result: Hardware selection; scores are reproducible across devices.
parameters.example: device='cpu' works without a GPU but is much slower.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Dataset hint for selecting the default affinity checkpoint. Supported: 'Robin', 'Biosensor'.
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines which pretrained checkpoint is loaded (e.g. Robin_random.pth), shifting the score distribution toward that training set.
parameters.example: dataset='Robin' selects the Robin checkpoint, which may generalize better to screening libraries similar to ROBIN.

constraints.other: 用于选择默认亲和力检查点的数据集提示。

parameters.name: split_method
parameters.description: Split-method hint for checkpoint selection. Supported: 'random', 'RNA', 'mol', 'both'.
parameters.impact_on_result: Chooses a checkpoint trained with a particular train/test split strategy, affecting generalization behavior.
parameters.example: split_method='RNA' selects a checkpoint where RNAs (not ligands) were held out during training, making it more suitable for novel RNA targets.

constraints.other: 用于检查点选择的划分策略提示。

parameters.name: rhofold_service_url
parameters.description: Microservice-only override for the RhoFold endpoint used when pdb_path is omitted.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes which structure-prediction service supplies the RNA PDB; a different RhoFold version or checkpoint can produce different coordinates and thus different scores.
parameters.example: Pointing rhofold_service_url at a remote RhoFold service with a fine-tuned checkpoint changes the generated PDB and the downstream GerNA score.

constraints.other: 可选的 RhoFold 服务端点 URL，用于自动生成 RNA 3D 结构。

score_rna_ligand_binding_with_gernabind.notes: GerNA-Bind internally uses RNA-FM embeddings, RNAfold (or a provided dot-bracket), and either a supplied PDB or a RhoFold-generated PDB. The affinity output is derived from Dirichlet parameters (raw_alpha) and reported as probability_positive = alpha[1] / sum(alpha).

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a PDB file containing the RNA-protein complex structure to score.
parameters.impact_on_result: Every geometric and graph feature is extracted from this PDB; different complex structures receive different native probabilities.
parameters.example: A near-native docking pose scores high (native_probability near 1.0), while a random decoy complex scores low (near 0.0).

constraints.other: 必须是包含 RNA-蛋白质复合物的 PDB 文件；上游 predict.py 通过 .pdb 后缀推导中间文件名。

parameters.name: academic
parameters.description: If True, use full academic mode with DSSR and NACCESS features. If False, use the reduced non-academic mode.
parameters.impact_on_result: Academic mode uses more biophysical descriptors (DSSR RNA secondary structure, NACCESS SASA) and is expected to be more accurate. Non-academic mode requires fewer third-party licenses but may have slightly lower discrimination.
parameters.example: academic=True may assign 0.92 to a native complex that academic=False scores 0.85.

constraints.other: True 启用完整学术模式（需要 DSSR + NACCESS 许可证）；False 使用降维非学术模式。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the EGARPS+ microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Switching to a remote EGARPS service returns the same probability if the same model weights and mode are used.

constraints.other: EGARPS+ 微服务端点 URL。

parameters.name: -mini (upstream-only flag)
parameters.description: Upstream predict.py supports a '-mini' flag that uses a single lightweight model in academic mode. Not exposed by the microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Uses a smaller ensemble, trading some accuracy for faster inference.
parameters.example: Running python predict.py -mini -non-academic is invalid; -mini must be used with academic mode.

score_rna_protein_complex_with_egarps.notes: EGARPS+ averages predictions from an ensemble of Graph_Model weights. Academic mode uses ['p1w1','p1w2','p1w3']; non-academic uses ['a1w1','a1w2','a1w3']. The output is a single native_probability produced by sigmoid(mean(logits)).

parameters.name: input_json_filepath
parameters.description: Path to an ODesign input JSON file following the upstream format (target structure, hotspot residues/atoms, chain_type, etc.).
parameters.impact_on_result: The JSON content defines the design task: target receptor, binding interface, molecule type (RNA/DNA/protein/ligand), and scaffold constraints. It is the dominant determinant of output.
parameters.example: An input JSON specifying an RNA backbone of length 30 produces a 30-nt RNA design; changing chain_type to dnaChain switches to DNA design.

constraints.other: 必须符合上游 ODesign 输入 JSON 格式（target、hotspot、chain_type 等）。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the ODesign microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Using a remote ODesign service does not change the generated molecules if the same checkpoint and seed are used.

parameters.name: infer_model_name
parameters.description: Upstream ODesign model checkpoint name (without .pt). Examples: odesign_base_na_rigid, odesign_base_prot_flex, odesign_base_prot_rigid, odesign_base_ligand_rigid.
parameters.impact_on_result: Selects the architecture and weights. The nucleic-acid model is required for RNA/DNA design; using a protein or ligand model for an RNA task will fail or produce invalid outputs.
parameters.example: infer_model_name='odesign_base_na_rigid' generates RNA/DNA backbones; 'odesign_base_prot_flex' generates flexible proteins.

constraints.other: 必须与 design_modality 匹配：核酸设计请使用 odesign_base_na_rigid。

parameters.name: design_modality
parameters.description: Design modality passed to ODesign. Must be one of: protein, ligand, dna, rna.
parameters.impact_on_result: Must match the model and input JSON chain_type. It determines which OInvFold checkpoint is loaded (oinvfold_rna.ckpt for rna).
parameters.example: design_modality='rna' with an rnaChain in the JSON produces RNA sequences; 'dna' produces DNA sequences.

constraints.other: RNA/DNA 设计必须配合 odesign_base_na_rigid 模型和 rnaChain/dnaChain。
constraints.source: external_repos/ODesign/README.md Available Models/Run Inference; microservices/odesign_service/main.py design_modality validation

parameters.name: exp_name
parameters.description: Custom experiment name for the output directory. If omitted, a unique name is auto-generated.
parameters.impact_on_result: Only affects output folder naming, not the generated molecules.
parameters.example: exp_name='my_rna_binder' creates outputs/my_rna_binder/ instead of a timestamped folder.

parameters.name: seeds_json
parameters.description: JSON list string of integer random seeds (e.g. '[42]' or '[42, 123]').
parameters.impact_on_result: Each seed produces an independent set of samples. Fixed seeds make outputs reproducible; different seeds explore the diffusion distribution.
parameters.example: seeds_json='[42, 101]' generates two independent batches of designs; '[42]' generates one batch.

constraints.other: JSON 列表字符串，元素为整数随机种子，不能为空列表。

parameters.name: n_sample
parameters.description: Number of generated samples per seed.
parameters.impact_on_result: More samples increase diversity and the chance of finding high-confidence designs but increase runtime linearly.
parameters.example: n_sample=1 returns one sample per seed; n_sample=10 returns ten.

parameters.name: use_msa
parameters.description: Whether the input JSON provides MSA features for ODesign inference.
parameters.impact_on_result: True enables MSA-conditioned generation, which can improve conservation-aware designs but requires valid MSA fields in the JSON.
parameters.example: use_msa=True with an RNA MSA path in the JSON biases generated sequences toward conserved positions.

parameters.name: num_workers
parameters.description: Number of dataloader workers.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects data-loading throughput and CPU usage. Too few workers can become a bottleneck; too many can exhaust CPU. Does not change the sampled molecules with deterministic settings.
parameters.example: num_workers=8 speeds up inference for a large batch compared with num_workers=0.

parameters.name: cuda_visible_devices
parameters.description: Override for CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (e.g. '0' or '0,1').
parameters.impact_on_result: Selects GPU(s). Multi-GPU may be used for distributed inference; results are deterministic for a fixed seed.
parameters.example: cuda_visible_devices='0,1' enables distributed inference across two GPUs.

constraints.other: 例如 '0' 或 '0,1'，用于设置 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES。

parameters.name: enable_partial_diff
parameters.description: Enable ODesign partial diffusion mode, which redesigns only specified regions of an existing molecule.
parameters.impact_on_result: True restricts sampling to the partial_diff region in the input JSON, preserving the rest of the structure. False generates the molecule from scratch.
parameters.example: enable_partial_diff=True with a partial_diff mask redesigns only a loop region of an existing RNA binder while keeping the stem fixed.

parameters.name: snr
parameters.description: Signal-to-noise ratio for partial diffusion.
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher SNR keeps more of the original structure signal, producing more conservative redesigns. Lower SNR allows larger deviations.
parameters.example: snr=0.5 preserves the original scaffold closely; snr=0.01 permits larger local changes.

constraints.other: 必须大于 0；仅在 enable_partial_diff=True 时生效。

parameters.name: ckpt_root_dir
parameters.description: Optional checkpoint root directory override.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes where ODesign looks for infer_model_name.pt and oinvfold_{modality}.ckpt, allowing custom or fine-tuned weights.
parameters.example: ckpt_root_dir='/custom/odesign_ckpt' loads a fine-tuned RNA design checkpoint.

parameters.name: data_root_dir
parameters.description: Optional data root directory override (must contain components.cif and rdkit pickle).
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects component dictionary lookup for ligand/protein residues. Different component versions may alter rare residues or ligands.
parameters.example: data_root_dir with an updated CCD may handle newly released modified nucleotides.

parameters.name: invfold_topk
parameters.description: Number of designed sequences per backbone structure from the inverse-folding head.
parameters.impact_on_result: Higher top-k returns more sequence candidates for each sampled backbone, increasing diversity at the sequence level.
parameters.example: invfold_topk=5 returns five sequences per backbone instead of one.

parameters.name: invfold_temp
parameters.description: Inverse-folding sampling temperature.
parameters.impact_on_result: Lower temperature makes inverse folding more confident/greedy; higher temperature increases sequence diversity.
parameters.example: invfold_temp=0.1 returns high-probability sequences close to the model's MAP estimate; invfold_temp=2.0 returns more diverse sequences.

constraints.other: 必须大于 0；逆折叠采样温度。

parameters.name: invfold_use_beam
parameters.description: Whether to use beam search in inverse folding.
parameters.impact_on_result: Beam search generally improves sequence quality and recovery compared with naive sampling but may reduce diversity.
parameters.example: invfold_use_beam=False may produce lower-recovery sequences for the same backbone.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Subprocess timeout for one ODesign inference request.
parameters.impact_on_result: Runtime guard only.
parameters.example: A large design task with n_sample=50 may need timeout_seconds=28800.

parameters.name: config architecture hyperparameters (upstream only)
parameters.description: Many architecture and diffusion hyperparameters (hidden dims, number of layers, noise schedule, etc.) live in the Hydra configs and are not exposed by the wrapper.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changing these would change the model architecture or diffusion process, but they are fixed in this deployment.
parameters.example: Modifying the number of transformer layers requires editing the YAML config and is outside the wrapper's interface.

run_odesign_inference.notes: ODesign uses Hydra for configuration. The microservice maps wrapper parameters to Hydra overrides (e.g. exp.model.sample_diffusion.N_sample). The input JSON content (hotspots, chain lengths, chain_type, partial_diff masks) is at least as important as the wrapper parameters.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: Path to a FASTA file containing the protein sequence(s).
parameters.impact_on_result: Determines the amino-acid sequence(s) to fold; different sequences produce entirely different structures.
parameters.example: A FASTA of ubiquitin (76 aa) versus a FASTA of lysozyme (129 aa) yields the corresponding folded structures.

constraints.other: FASTA 文件，包含一条或多条蛋白质序列；序列由 20 种标准氨基酸单字母代码组成。

parameters.name: num_models
parameters.description: Number of inference samples to generate. The Protenix CLI default is 5; the microservice defaults to 1 but the wrapper overrides to 5.
parameters.impact_on_result: More models increase diversity and the chance of a high-confidence prediction, but increase runtime linearly. The best-ranked model (sample_0) is returned.
parameters.example: num_models=1 returns a single model; num_models=5 returns an ensemble and selects the top-ranked one.

constraints.source: microservices/proteinx_service/main.py ProteinXPredictRequest num_models; Protenix CLI --sample default=5

parameters.name: num_recycles
parameters.description: Number of Pairformer cycles. Ignored when use_default_params is True.
parameters.impact_on_result: More recycles allow iterative refinement of the structure and usually improve accuracy at the cost of runtime.
parameters.example: num_recycles=1 gives a fast but coarse model; num_recycles=10 gives a slower, refined model.

constraints.other: Pairformer cycle 数量；当 use_default_params=True 时被忽略（上游默认 10）。
constraints.source: microservices/proteinx_service/main.py ProteinXPredictRequest num_recycles; Protenix CLI --cycle default=10

parameters.name: stop_at_score
parameters.description: Early stopping threshold based on pLDDT. Documented as not enforced by Protenix.
parameters.impact_on_result: Currently has no practical effect because the CLI does not implement early stopping at this threshold.
parameters.example: stop_at_score=90 does not cause early stopping; the parameter is kept for interface compatibility.

constraints.other: 基于 pLDDT 的早停阈值，当前 Protenix CLI 未实际实现。

parameters.name: msa_mode
parameters.description: MSA generation mode. 'none' disables MSA; 'protenix' enables the Protenix MSA server.
parameters.impact_on_result: Using MSA can improve accuracy for proteins with many homologs by providing evolutionary information; it requires network access or a local MSA server and increases runtime.
parameters.example: msa_mode='protenix' may improve a ubiquitin-family protein prediction; msa_mode='none' folds from a single sequence.

constraints.other: 'none' 禁用 MSA；'protenix' 启用 Protenix MSA 服务器。

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the ProteinX microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Using a remote service does not change the structure if the same model and seed are used.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Wrapper-level request timeout.
parameters.impact_on_result: Runtime guard only.
parameters.example: A 500-residue protein may need timeout_seconds=7200 instead of 3600.

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: Protenix model checkpoint name. Microservice-only; the wrapper does not expose it.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes the trained model weights and architecture version. Different versions can give different structures and confidence scores.
parameters.example: model_name='protenix-v2' may improve accuracy but requires additional download permissions.

constraints.other: protenix-v2 需要额外下载权限。

parameters.name: use_default_params
parameters.description: If True, use recommended default parameters for the selected model (num_recycles is ignored). Microservice-only.
parameters.impact_on_result: When True, the CLI ignores num_recycles and uses the model's default recycle count and diffusion steps. When False, num_recycles is honored.
parameters.example: use_default_params=True uses the model's recommended 10 recycles regardless of num_recycles=3.

constraints.other: True 时使用模型推荐默认参数，num_recycles 被忽略。

parameters.name: step (upstream CLI)
parameters.description: Number of diffusion steps in the Protenix CLI. Not exposed by wrapper/microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: More steps generally improve structure quality and confidence but increase runtime.
parameters.example: step=50 is fast but lower quality; step=200 is standard; step=500 is very slow.

parameters.name: dtype (upstream CLI)
parameters.description: Inference data type (bf16, fp16, fp32). Not exposed by wrapper.
parameters.impact_on_result: Affects speed, memory, and numerical precision. fp32 is most accurate but slowest; bf16 is faster with minor precision loss.
parameters.example: dtype='fp16' halves memory usage but may slightly alter confidence scores.

predict_protein_structure_with_proteinx.notes: The microservice hardcodes model_name='protenix_base_default_v1.0.0' and use_default_params=True, so the wrapper's num_recycles is currently ignored unless the microservice is modified. The Protenix CLI offers additional options (templates, RNA MSA, kernel choices) that are not exposed by this wrapper.

parameters.name: protein_filepath
parameters.description: Path to a FASTA file containing the protein sequence.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the protein chain in the complex; changing it predicts a different protein partner.
parameters.example: A FASTA of human FMRP versus bacterial L7Ae yields different RNA-protein complexes with the same RNA.

constraints.other: FASTA 文件，包含蛋白质序列；序列由 20 种标准氨基酸单字母代码组成。

parameters.name: rna_filepath
parameters.description: Path to a FASTA file containing the RNA sequence.
parameters.impact_on_result: Defines the RNA chain; different RNAs fold and bind the protein differently.
parameters.example: Using the SLIP1-bound RNA versus a scrambled RNA changes the predicted interface and ipTM.

constraints.other: FASTA 文件，包含 RNA 序列；归一化后仅保留 A/U/G/C，T 转 U。

parameters.name: num_models
parameters.description: Number of inference samples to generate.
parameters.impact_on_result: More models increase the chance of finding a high-confidence complex pose; the best-ranked model is returned.
parameters.example: num_models=1 returns one complex; num_models=5 returns five ranked models.

parameters.name: num_recycles
parameters.description: Number of Pairformer cycles. Ignored when use_default_params is True.
parameters.impact_on_result: More recycles refine the complex interface and usually improve ipTM and pLDDT.
parameters.example: num_recycles=3 gives a fast complex prediction; num_recycles=10 gives a more refined interface.

constraints.other: Pairformer cycle 数量；当 use_default_params=True 时被忽略。

parameters.name: msa_mode
parameters.description: MSA generation mode. 'none' disables MSA; 'protenix' enables the Protenix MSA server.
parameters.impact_on_result: MSA can improve accuracy for conserved protein/RNA families but requires MSA infrastructure.
parameters.example: msa_mode='protenix' may improve a ribosomal protein-RNA complex prediction.

parameters.name: service_url
parameters.description: HTTP endpoint of the ProteinX complex microservice.
parameters.impact_on_result: Routing only.
parameters.example: Remote endpoint with the same model returns the same complex (modulo nondeterminism).

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Wrapper-level request timeout.
parameters.impact_on_result: Runtime guard only.
parameters.example: A large ribonucleoprotein complex may need timeout_seconds=14400.

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: Protenix model checkpoint name. Microservice-only; wrapper does not expose it.
parameters.impact_on_result: Changes the trained weights and model version, affecting complex topology, interface quality, and confidence metrics.
parameters.example: model_name='protenix_base_default_v1.0.0' is the default; newer versions may give different interfaces.

parameters.name: use_default_params
parameters.description: Use recommended default parameters for the selected model. Microservice-only.
parameters.impact_on_result: When True, num_recycles is ignored and the model's default recycle count is used.
parameters.example: use_default_params=True uses the model's default recycles regardless of wrapper num_recycles=10.

parameters.name: step / dtype / use_template / use_rna_msa (upstream CLI)
parameters.description: Additional Protenix CLI flags not exposed by the wrapper. They control diffusion steps, precision, templates, and RNA MSA.
parameters.impact_on_result: These affect runtime, memory, and prediction accuracy but are fixed in the current wrapper.
parameters.example: use_rna_msa=True would enable RNA MSA conditioning, but the wrapper does not expose it.

predict_rna_protein_complex_with_protein.notes: For complex prediction, the microservice constructs a Protenix input JSON with one proteinChain and one rnaSequence. Like the protein endpoint, model_name and use_default_params are hardcoded in the microservice, so the wrapper's num_recycles is effectively ignored unless the microservice is changed. The output includes ipTM, which measures interface quality.
